blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Many hierarchical byte-level language models group bytes into patches using a learned boundary predictor whose view of the next codepoint depends on encoding and lookahead. In UTF-8, codepoints of many scripts take three bytes: 8 of 24 bits mark length and continuation, and the first byte carries only 4 high codepoint bits. After the same left context, a mark extending a grapheme cluster and a letter starting the next can thus share their first byte. Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE) keeps one- and two-byte UTF-8 encodings but writes these codepoints as two UTF-16 bytes, low byte first, so its first symbol carries 8 low codepoint bits that can distinguish such continuations. We train small causal predictors on matched FineWeb-2 text and evaluate on FLORES-200 under UTF-8, UBE, and UBE's same-length big-endian variant. At one-symbol lookahead, balanced grapheme-boundary error at codepoint boundaries across 17 languages in 13 Brahmic scripts is 8.76% with UTF-8, 8.62% with the big-endian variant, and 0.06% with UBE. When the target instead retains a parent tokenizer's subword cuts at grapheme boundaries, UBE lowers the mean error relative to UTF-8 at the same lookahead by 72.91% in Korean, 35.29% in Chinese, and 67.32-99.55% in eight more scripts. In the seven of them whose main Unicode block fits on one 256-codepoint page, the big-endian variant stays within 3.0% of UTF-8, so the gain follows byte order, not length. In Korean and Chinese, UBE's mean error falls below UTF-8's final mean error after only 25% and 37.5% of training. Which byte comes first thus affects how much lookahead a byte-level boundary predictor needs.
blocks.zh: 许多分级字节级语言模型将字节组合成补丁,使用一个已学习到的边界预测器,其下个代码点的视图取决于编码和取景. 在UTF-8中,许多脚本的代码点取出3个字节:8个24位标记长度和续作,而第一个字节只携带了4个高代码点比特. 在同一左上下文之后,延伸出一个图案组的标记和开始下一个字母的字母可以因此共享他们的第一个字节. Universal Byte-level Encoding (UBE) 保留了一字节和二字节的UTF-8编码,但将这些编码点写为两个UTF-16字节,先是低字节,因此其第一个符号带有8个能区分这种续作的低码点位. 我们在匹配的FineWeb-2文本上训练出小的因果预测器,并在UTF-8,UBE和UBE的同长大-endian变体下对FLORES-200进行评价. 在一同位素外观上,13个婆罗洲脚本中跨越17个语言的编码点边界的平衡相图边界误差为:以UTF-8为8.76%;以大端变体为8.62%;以UBE为0.06%. 当目标在石墨边界上保留了母标注器的子字切分时,UBE将相同外观前方的UTF-8的正差降低72.91%的韩文,35.29%的中文和67.32-99.55%的再8个脚本. 其中7个主Unicode块适合一个256个码点的页面,大端变体停留在UTF-8的3.0%以内,因此增益遵循字节顺序,不是长度. 在韩语和汉语中,UBE的平均出错仅经过了25%和37.5%的训练后就低于UTF-8的最终出错. 因此,哪一个字节首先会影响一个字节级的边界预测器的外观。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
In hierarchical byte-level language models with learned patching, a boundary predictor groups the input into patches for the global transformer.
The character distinctions needed to predict these units depend on the writing system and the segmentation target.
Consider a grapheme cluster, Unicode’s approximation to a written character, which may combine a base with dependent marks.
After identical left context, one-byte lookahead at a codepoint boundary in UTF-8 can reveal the same byte for a mark extending the current cluster and a letter starting the next.
The required decisions then remain indistinguishable even when the target segmentation is unambiguous.
Byte-level models can process text in any language out of the box ( Xue et al., 2022 ) ; at limited lookahead, however, the encoding does not expose every script’s distinctions equally.
When clusters consist of single codepoints, the task changes: a subword boundary predictor must select which inter-character boundaries to retain.
These tasks require different distinctions, motivating us to study encoding choice in relation to both the script and the boundary target.
blocks.zh:
在带有学习补丁的分级字节级语言模型中,一个边界预测器将输入到全局变压器的补丁中.
预测这些单位所需的字符区分取决于书写系统和分割目标.
考虑一个图案集群,Unicode对一个书面字符的近似,它可能将一个碱基与依赖标记结合.
在相同的左上下文之后,UTF-8中一个代码点边界的单字节查看头可以显示一个扩展当前集群的标记和从下一个开始的字母的相同字节.
因此,即使目标划分明确,所要求的决定仍然无法区分。
字节级模型可以从框中任意一种语言处理文本(Xue等人,2022年);然而,在有限的望头,编码并不平等地暴露每个脚本的区别.
当集群由单个代码点组成时,任务会改变:一个子词边界预测器必须选择保留哪个字符间边界.
这些任务需要不同的区分,激励我们研究与脚本和边界目标相关的编码选择.

blocks.en:
The encoding affects both how densely codepoint bits are packed and which bits reach the predictor first.
For a Unicode scalar (a codepoint other than a surrogate) that takes three UTF-8 bytes, the pattern 1110xxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx carries 16 codepoint bits and 8 length/continuation bits ( The Unicode Consortium, 2025 ) .
The same scalar occupies 16 bits in UTF-16 without those markers, so UTF-8 is inherently less compact for such scalars.
We use the existing Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE; Kim and Jung, 2026 ), which retains one- and two-byte UTF-8 encodings and uses UTF-16 little-endian (UTF-16LE) for longer ones.
For three-byte UTF-8 scalars, UBE therefore shortens the representation to two symbols and presents 8 low codepoint bits in the first symbol, where UTF-8 presents only 4 high bits.
Within a known 256-codepoint page, that byte identifies the codepoint.
When a letter and a dependent mark occupy different positions on that page, UBE therefore exposes the distinction needed to start or extend a cluster in its first symbol, even if their UTF-8 prefixes coincide.
Codepoints on different pages can still share a low byte.
Figure 1 previews the boundary errors of small predictors trained on each encoding; Figure 2 shows why the first byte can hide or expose the required distinction.
The worked example in Appendix C illustrates the cluster fragmentation that motivates our targets.
blocks.zh:
编码既会影响编码点的密集度位被打包的方式,又会影响哪个位位先到达预测器.
对于一个需要三个UTF-8字节的Unicode scalar(代号以外的一个编码点),图案1110xx10xxx10xxxxx10xxxxxxxx)搭载16个代码点位和8个长度/连续位(Unicode Consortium,2025).
同样的scalar在UTF-16中占据了16位,没有这些标记,因此对于这样的scalars来说,UTF-8本质上不那么紧凑.
我们使用现有的通用字节级编码(UBE; Kim and Jung, 2026),它保留了1字节和2字节的UTF-8编码,并且使用UTF-16小endian(UTF-16LE)进行更长的编码.
对于三字节的UTF-8 scalars,UBE因此将表示缩短为两个符号,并在第一个符号中呈现8个低码点位,其中UTF-8只呈现4个高位.
在已知的256个编码点的页面中,该字节识别该编码点.
当一个字母和一个依赖的标记在该页上占据不同位置时,UBE因此暴露了在第一个符号中开始或扩展一个集群所需的区分,即使它们的UTF-8前缀是吻合的.
不同页面上的代码点仍然可以共享一个低字节.
图1预览了每个编码上训练的小预测器的边界错误;图2显示了为什么第一个字节可以隐藏或暴露所需的区分.
附录C中的例子说明,集群分散推动了我们的目标。

blocks.en:
Our motivating application is byteification , the conversion of a pretrained subword language model into a model that reads and emits bytes.
Bolmo surrounds the parent transformer with local modules and trains a boundary predictor on the parent’s subword segmentation; the global transformer then operates on the resulting patches ( Minixhofer et al., 2025 ; Minixhofer et al., 2026 ) .
Byteification thus removes the tokenizer from the model’s interface but transfers its segmentation criterion along with the weights: the patches are still learned from the parent’s cuts (Section 5.2 ).
Bolmo raises the question of what models inherit from the input encoding and suggests alternatives to UTF-8 ( Minixhofer et al., 2025 , Section 8) ; Haltiuk (2026) reports nearly inherited Bolmo boundaries and proposes separating boundary placement from language modeling.
We focus on how to construct cluster-aligned targets and expose the distinctions needed to predict them with limited lookahead.
The targets either include every grapheme boundary or retain only the parent-tokenizer cuts that already coincide with one.
We use grapheme clusters because their boundaries are representable in every encoding, position-only cluster targets are invariant to span-preserving edits, and cluster continuations are where encodings differ in what the first symbol reveals (Section 3 ); the choice does not presuppose that clusters are better modeling units.
blocks.zh:
我们的激励应用是字节化,将一个预先训练过的子词语言模型转换成一个读出字节的模型.
Bolmo用本地模块包围母变压器,并在母变压器的子词分区上训练一个边界预测器;然后全球变压器在由此产生的补丁上运行(Minixhofer等人,2025年;Minixhofer等人,2026年).
因此,字节化从模型的界面中去除了标定剂,但转移其分解标准与权重:补丁仍然从母体的切除中吸取(第5.2节)。
Bolmo提出了从输入编码中继承哪些模型的问题,并提出了UTF-8的替代品(Minixhofer等人,2025年,第8节);Hartiuk(2026年)报告几乎继承了Bolmo的边界,并提议将边界位置与语言模型区分开来.
我们侧重于如何构建集群对应目标,并揭露以有限的视线预测这些目标所需的区别。
目标要么包括每个石墨边界,要么只保留已经与一个边界相吻合的亲切开关。
我们使用石墨星团,因为其边界可以代表每个编码,只代表位置的星团目标不易变换来截断保留编辑,星团续作是第一个符号显示的编码不同的地方(第3节);选择时并不预先假定星团是更好的建模单位.

(b) After the same Devanagari base, vowel sign I extends the cluster and letter MA starts a new one (outlined: target clusters; dotted circle: isolated mark). Both scalars share the high byte 09 , so their first symbols coincide under UTF-8 and UBE-BE and differ only under UBE (P5, Section 3 ). blocks.en:
We train small causal boundary predictors on matched FineWeb-2 text ( Penedo et al., 2025 ) under UTF-8, UBE, and UBE-BE, a big-endian variant with UBE’s routing and stream length.
UBE differs from UTF-8 in both stream length and byte order; UBE-BE keeps UBE’s length but reverses the bytes within each UTF-16 code unit, allowing a byte-order comparison at fixed stream length.
For the every-cluster target on the 17-language FLORES-200 panel ( NLLB Team et al., 2022 ) , one-symbol lookahead yields 8.76% balanced error at scalar ends with UTF-8 and 0.06% with UBE.
UBE-BE gives 8.62%, implicating byte order beyond stream shortening alone.
False cuts inside scalars are measured separately; a rule-based mask can remove them without changing any decision at scalar ends (Section 4 ).
On constructed pairs with identical left context whose next scalars lie on the same 256-codepoint page but require opposite decisions, the trained UBE predictors answer all 17,204 pairs correctly at one-symbol lookahead in each seed; UTF-8 and UBE-BE cannot, because both continuations begin with the same symbol.
blocks.zh:
在UTF-8、UBE和UBE-BE这个具有UBE的路由和流线长度的大型变体下,
UBE在流长和字节顺序上都与UTF-8不同;UBE-BE保持UBE的长度,但在每个UTF-16代码单元内反转字节,允许在固定的流长上进行字节顺序比较.
对于17种语言的FLORES-200面板(NLLB Team 等人,2022年)上的每组目标,单音节外观头部的平衡误差为8.76%,末端为UTF-8,0.06%为UBE.
UBE-BE给出8.62%, 包含的字节顺序 超出溪流缩短单独。
刀片内部的假切片是单独测量的;基于规则的面具可以在刀片末端不改变任何决定的情况下去掉它们(第4节.
在具有相同左上下文的构造配对上,其下个scalars位于相同的256-codepoint页面,但需要相反的决定,经过训练的UBE预测器在每个种子的单音节外观前正确回答所有17,204对;UTF-8和UBE-BE不能,因为两者的续作都以相同的符号开头.

blocks.en:
Korean and Chinese provide a complementary test: every evaluated cluster is a single scalar, so the retained-parent task selects among inter-character boundaries.
In this separate extension, UBE reduces total retained-parent errors relative to UTF-8 by 72.91% and 35.29%, respectively, at one-symbol lookahead.
These totals include false cuts inside scalars, and every seed favors UBE over both UTF-8 and UBE-BE in each language.
Grapheme boundaries here coincide with scalar ends, which every encoding exposes, so the gain concerns subword selection (Section 4.1 ).
In eight more scripts, UBE reduces retained-parent errors by 67.32–99.55% at one-symbol lookahead, and where a script’s main Unicode block lies on one 256-codepoint page, the same-length UBE-BE control stays close to UTF-8 (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh:
韩语和汉语提供了一种互补的测试:每个被评价的集群都是单一的scalar,因此保留-母任务在字符间边界中选择.
在这个单独的扩展中,UBE将单音节外观头部相对于UTF-8的总保留母错误分别减少72.91%和35.29%.
这些总数包括假切片内切片,每个种子偏好UBE在每种语言中都优于UTF-8和UBE-BE.
这里的Grapheme边界与scalar的结尾相吻合,每个编码都会暴露这一点,所以收益涉及子词选择(第4.1节).
在另外8个脚本中,UBE将保留-母错误减少67.32–99.55%的单音节外观,如果一个脚本的主Unicode块位于一个256码点的页面上,则相同的长度UBE-BE控制保持接近UTF-8(第4.2节).

blocks.en:
An audit of released conversions motivates the target construction.
Bwen-8B, a released Bolmo-style conversion of Qwen3-8B-Base ( Minixhofer et al., 2025 ; Minixhofer et al., 2026 ) , retains at least 97.07% of its parent’s interior cuts in each of 18 selected high-fragmentation languages, and its cluster-internal cut count stays within 1.54% of the parent’s.
Deleting cluster-internal cuts yields supervision that respects cluster boundaries and is representable under UTF-8, UTF-16, and UBE.
On the 17-language panel, this deletion reduces target units per normalized codepoint from 6.10 × \times to 2.25 × \times the English rate.
Complementary corruption and scoring analyses characterize the released segmentation and establish how to compare a conversion with its parent.
blocks.zh:
对释放的转化进行审核,激发目标建设的积极性.
Bwen-8B是Qwen3-8B-Base(Minixhofer等人,2025年;Minixhofer等人,2026年)的一种释放出来的Bolmo风格转换,在18种选定的高分化语言中,其母体内部切数至少保留了97.07%,其组群内部切数保持在母体的1.54%以内.
删除集群内切产生尊重集群边界的监管,并在UTF-8,UTF-16和UBE下具有代表性.
在17语言面板上,这一删除将每个规范化的代码点的目标单位从6.10×\时减少到2.25×\时的英语率.
补充腐败和评分分析是释放的分化特征,并确定了如何将转换与其母体进行比较。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are: • An analysis of the information available for boundary prediction at limited lookahead, tested with trained UTF-8, UBE, and UBE-BE predictors on grapheme and retained subword targets. • Cluster-aligned boundary targets with explicit integrity, representability, and invariance conditions, separating target construction from learned boundary decisions. • An audit of grapheme fragmentation in released conversions, with sequence-length accounting, corruption diagnostics, and a scoring protocol for parent/conversion comparisons. All model diagnostics use released checkpoints and the FLORES-200 devtest split; the boundary predictors train on FineWeb-2 and are evaluated on FLORES-200.
P1–P4 (Section 3 ) are properties of the targets that hold by construction; P5 is an information limit for causal predictors with limited lookahead; Section 4 measures trained probes and Section 5 measures released checkpoints.
blocks.zh:
• 我们的贡献是: 分析在有限的望头进行边界预测的现有信息,通过经过训练的UTF-8,UBE,以及UBE-BE预测器在石墨上进行测试,并保留了子词目标. • 组合边界目标具有明显的完整性、代表性和变化性条件,将目标构建与学到的边界决定分开。 对释放的转换中的石墨碎裂情况进行审计,进行序列长度核算,腐败诊断,并对母体/转换比较进行评分协议. 所有模型诊断都使用已放行的检查站和FLORES-200devtest拆分;FineWeb-2上的边界预测器列车和FLORES-200上的评价.
P1-P4(第3节)是施工目标的性质;P5是视线有限的因果预测器的信息限制;第4节措施训练有素的探测器和第5节措施释放检查站。

blocks.en: 2 Background: Encodings and Byteification
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况: 编码和字节化

blocks.en: Figure 3: Three mechanisms of tokenizer inheritance and two sequence lengths. Blue solid arrows trace input encoding, green dash-dotted arrows vocabulary features, and orange dashed arrows boundary supervision. Cluster alignment changes the supervision target; encoding choice changes the local symbol stream. Transferring the vocabulary features to UBE requires a separate alignment policy.
blocks.zh: 图3:3 代币继承的三种机制以及两个序列长度. 蓝色固态箭头追踪输入编码,绿色破折号箭头词汇特征,橙色破折号箭头边界监管. 集群对齐会改变监管目标;编码选择会改变本地符号流. 将词汇特性转移给UBE需要单独的对齐政策.

blocks.en:
We use cluster to mean a UAX #29 extended grapheme cluster ( Hadley, 2025 ) , operationalized by regex ’s \X on text in Unicode Normalization Form C (NFC).
All codepoints in our normalized text are scalars.
A cluster can contain several scalars, each represented by one or more encoded symbols.
Grapheme clusters do not necessarily coincide with linguistic characters or orthographic syllables.
We therefore distinguish scalar, cluster, and symbol counts throughout.
blocks.zh:
我们使用集群表示UAX #29扩展的石墨集群(哈德利,2025年),
我们正版文本中的所有代码都是标点
一个集群可以包含几个scalars,每个符号由一个或多个编码符号代表.
Grapheme集群不一定与语言字符或正体音节重合.
因此,我们在整个过程中都区分了标尺、集群和符号。

blocks.en:
Word-spacing conventions are distinct from grapheme structure.
Korean regularly separates eojeols , spacing units that can contain multiple morphemes, whereas Chinese generally leaves word boundaries unmarked by spaces ( Lee et al., 2026a ; Hwang et al., 2026 ) .
In neither language do whitespace boundaries define subword segmentation; Unicode grapheme and word boundaries are also distinct ( Hadley, 2025 ) .
We therefore distinguish whitespace-adjacent gaps from other scalar gaps when analyzing the Korean/Chinese extension.
blocks.zh:
文字间隔公约不同于图表结构。
朝鲜语经常将eojeols分离,其间距单位可以包含多个摩尔phes,而汉语则一般会留下无空间标记的字词边界(Lee等人,2026a; Hwang et al., 2026 (英语).
在两种语言中,白空边界都不定义子词区划;Unicode phrameme和单词区划也是截然不同的(Hadley, 2025 ).
因此,我们在分析韩/中扩展时,将白空间相邻的空隙与其他平面空隙区分开来。

blocks.en:
UBE uses disjoint UTF-8 and UTF-16LE byte alphabets, with 256 symbols each ( Kim and Jung, 2026 ) .
One- and two-byte UTF-8 scalars stay in UTF-8; three-byte scalars in the Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) use two UTF-16LE byte symbols; supplementary scalars use four UTF-16LE symbols.
A UBE symbol identifies both a byte value and its encoding route; lookahead is measured in symbols.
The encoding changes stream length and byte order but does not itself prevent a learned predictor from cutting inside a scalar or cluster.

blocks.en:
FLORES-200 provides parallel translated sentences ( NLLB Team et al., 2022 ) .
The boundary audit uses 22 languages with 1,012 sentences each, 22,264 sentences in total: 18 focal languages, namely those covered by Belebele ( Bandarkar et al., 2024 ) among the 30 FLORES-200 languages in which the Qwen3 tokenizer places a token boundary inside the largest share of non-ASCII scalars, and English, Russian, Thai, and Simplified Chinese as controls.
The lookahead probe and the cost and corruption analyses use a 17-language panel in 13 Brahmic scripts: the eligible focal languages plus Thai.
Amharic and Tigrinya cannot supply a substitutable mark pool, while English, Russian, and Chinese fail at least one of the two corruption conditions (mark and base substitution; Section 5.5 ); those three languages remain reference points in the cost accounting.

FLORES-200提供并行的翻译句子(NLLB Team et al., 2022).
边界审计使用22种语言,每句1,012句,共计22,264句:18种语调,即30种FLORES-200语言中包括的Belebele语言(Bandarkar等人,2024年),其中Qune3标语器在非ASCII标语中最大比例的标语边界,以及英语,俄语,泰语和简化汉语作为控制.

阿姆哈拉语和提格里尼亚语无法提供可替代的标记池,而英语,俄语和汉语至少未能达到两种腐败条件中的一种(标记和基准替代;第5.5节);这三种语言仍然是成本核算中的参考点.

blocks.en:
Bolmo combines a local encoder, a boundary predictor, the inherited global transformer, and a local decoder.
The released predictor uses one-byte lookahead during prefill, which its authors found largely sufficient to match subword tokenization ( Minixhofer et al., 2026 ) ; the decoder jointly predicts a byte and its patch-end flag.
The output alphabet has ( 4 + 256 ) × 2 = 520 (4+256)\times 2=520 identifiers, including special tokens.
During Stage 1, the initial distillation stage, parent cuts supervise the predictor; at inference, the predictor supplies its own boundaries.
blocks.zh:
博尔莫结合了本地编码器,边界预测器,继承的全球变速器,以及本地解码器.
发行的预测器在预填时使用单字节的外观,其作者认为这基本足以匹配子词的符号化(Minixhofer等人,2026年);解码器联合预测一个字节及其补丁端旗.
输出字母有(4+256)×2=520(4+256)\times 2=520标识符,包括特殊符符.
在第一阶段,即初始蒸馏阶段,母切监督预测器;推论,预测器提供自己的边界。

blocks.en:
The parent tokenizer enters this architecture through three mechanisms (Figure 3 ).
First, the released input pipeline applies the parent tokenizer and concatenates the bytes of its pieces, preserving its NFC normalization but discarding the piece boundaries from the byte stream.
Second, a reversed byte trie retrieves the longest parent-vocabulary suffix ending at each byte position and adds its embedding to the byte embedding.
These suffix matches need not coincide with tokens in the canonical BPE segmentation.
Third, Stage 1 supervises the boundary predictor with the parent’s segmentation while the global transformer remains frozen.
The three mechanisms must be distinguished when interpreting inherited boundaries.
blocks.zh:
母代码化器通过三个机制(图3)进入此架构.
首先,释放的输入管应用了母代碼器,并凝固其片段的字节,保持了其NFC的正常化,但将片段边界从字节流中丢弃.
第二,一个反转的字节 trie 检索每个字节位置结束的最长的父-vocabulary后缀,并将其嵌入到字节嵌入中.
这些后缀匹配不需要与犬科植物BPE分型中的符号重合.
第三,第1阶段是在全球变压器仍然冷冻的情况下,对母体的分解进行边界预测。
这三个机制在解释继承边界时必须加以区分。

blocks.en:
Bolmo’s public Qwen conversion recipe 1 1 1 The code is at github.com/allenai/bolmo-core (commit 2d8178b). weights the local-encoder, cross-entropy, local-decoder, and boundary losses by [ 1 , 1 , 1 , 4 ] [1,1,1,4] .
In Stage 2, which trains all parameters end to end, Bolmo can optionally supervise merged subsets of the parent’s boundaries to raise compression ( Minixhofer et al., 2025 , Section 5.1) .
Although the same implementation provides several boundary-compression modes, its Stage-1 entry point rejects gradual boundary compression.
Changing the Stage-1 boundary target therefore requires adapting the Stage-1 pipeline and its alignment to the teacher.

虽然同样的执行提供了几种边界压缩模式,但是其Stage-1入口拒绝渐进边界压缩.
因此,改变阶段一的边界目标需要调整阶段一的管道并使其与教师保持一致。

blocks.en: 3 Boundary Targets and the First Byte
blocks.zh: 3 边界目标和第一个字节

blocks.en:
We define targets in text coordinates so that encoding comparisons preserve the segmentation task.
P1–P4 constrain the target; P5 concerns what a causal predictor can observe when it must reproduce it.
Let G ⁡ ( x ) G(x) be the set of interior cluster boundaries, represented in scalar coordinates.
For an encoding a a that represents each scalar as a contiguous, nonempty sequence of symbols, let L a ​ ( x ) L_{a}(x) denote the stream length and ϕ a \phi_{a} map scalar boundaries to symbol boundaries.
A cluster-aligned target is any set T ⁡ ( x ) ⊆ G ⁡ ( x ) T(x)\subseteq G(x) , realized in the encoded stream as ϕ a ​ ( T ​ ( x ) ) \phi_{a}(T(x)) .
This condition constrains the supervision ; a learned predictor can still deviate from it.
It accommodates different compression criteria: parent-BPE, entropy-based, or fixed-rate cuts can be restricted to G ⁡ ( x ) G(x) once their offsets are expressed in common coordinates.
The retained-parent construction below removes only the cuts that violate cluster alignment.

blocks.en:
Every target cut is between clusters, hence between scalars.
Both A in A_{\mathrm{in}} and B in B_{\mathrm{in}} are zero for the target by construction.
This property follows from the target definition, independently of token frequency or predictor accuracy.
blocks.zh:

A在A_{\mathrm{in}},B_{\mathrm{in}})中A在B_{\mathrm{in}},通过构建对目标都是零.
这种属性来自目标定义,独立于符号频率或预测准确性.

blocks.en:
Each retained scalar boundary has a direct image under ϕ a \phi_{a} , avoiding any need to remap a cut inside a scalar.
For a nonempty sentence with K K clusters, | T ⁡ ( x ) | + 1 ≤ K ⁡ ( x ) ≤ L a ​ ( x ) . |T(x)|+1\leq K(x)\leq L_{a}(x). (1) Every target in this family is therefore representable in the encoded stream, a property that unrestricted parent cuts need not satisfy (Section 5.3 ).
For example, the measured Odia text has 82,869 clusters and 248,774 UBE symbols.
UTF-8, UTF-16, and UBE can thus represent the same target segmentation despite their different stream lengths.
Vocabulary-feature transfer and the accuracy of the learned predictor remain separate questions.

Let C P C_{P} be the parent cut set in UTF-8 byte coordinates.
The retained-parent target, denoted T ret T_{\rm ret} , keeps exactly the cuts that already coincide with cluster boundaries: T ret ​ ( x ) \displaystyle T_{\rm ret}(x) = { g ∈ G ⁡ ( x ) : ϕ UTF8 ​ ( g ) ∈ C P ​ ( x ) } , \displaystyle=\{g\in G(x):\phi_{\rm UTF8}(g)\in C_{P}(x)\}, (2) N ret \displaystyle N_{\rm ret} = N P − A in ​ ( P ) . \displaystyle=N_{P}-A_{\mathrm{in}}(P). This is a deletion-only operation: it preserves every compatible parent cut and neither relocates nor inserts a boundary.
Only the surviving cuts require scalar coordinates.
On the 17-language panel (Table 5 ), the resulting target has 0.4705 units per codepoint, compared with 0.2093 in English, a ratio of 2.25 × \times .
The operation reduces the panel’s parent-unit count by 63.15% and leaves the English target unchanged.
These are target counts; realized counts depend on the learned predictor.

保留型父母目标表示 T ret T_{\rm ret} 保留已与集群边界一致的切口 : T ret (x)\displaystyle T_{\rm ret} (x) = { g∈ ⁡ G⁡ (x) : φ UTF8 (g) ∈ C P (x) },\displaystyle =\{\ in G(x):\phi_{\rm UTF8} (g)\in C_{ P}(x) \}, (2) N ret\displaystyle N_{\rm ret}= N P − A in (P). \displaystyle=N_{P}- A_{\mathrm{in}}(P). 这是一个只删除的操作:它保存每个兼容的父切,既不移动也不插入边框.

blocks.en:
A target determined solely by cluster-boundary positions is invariant, in scalar coordinates, to the span-preserving corruptions in Section 5.5 .
Examples include every cluster boundary and every m m th cluster boundary from the start.
The corruption constructor verifies equality of the complete cluster-span list; equal UTF-8 width of the substituted scalars also preserves offsets under UTF-8, UTF-16, and UBE.
Content-dependent targets, including the retained-parent target, need not be invariant because the selection among valid cluster boundaries can change.
Even for an invariant target, the learned predictor may respond differently to the edited text.
blocks.zh:
完全由集群边界位置确定的目标,在标尺坐标上,对于第5.5节中截断的腐败而言,是不一致的。
例子包括每个集群边界和每个m m th 集群边界从一开始.
腐败构建器验证完整的集群-宽度列表的等值;替代的标尺的等宽UTF-8宽度也保留UTF-8,UTF-16和UBE下的抵消.
依赖内容的目标,包括保留-母目标,不一定是变化无常的,因为在有效的集群界限中的选择可以改变。
即使对于一个变化无常的目标,所学的预测器也可能对编辑过的文本做出不同的反应.

blocks.en:
Deleting cuts both aligns and lengthens patches, requiring Stage-1 teacher representations and decoder targets to be aligned to the merged spans.
A comparison that attributes a quality change specifically to cluster alignment must control for the accompanying reduction in patch count.
Appendix L specifies these comparison conditions.
blocks.zh:
删除同时切除校对和加长补丁,要求阶段一的师资表述和解码目标与合并的跨度一致.
将质量变化具体归因于集群对齐的比较,必须控制补丁计数的相应减少。
附 录 L规定了这些比较条件。

blocks.en:
Under the released end-boundary convention, the predictor compares projections of local-encoder states h i h_{i} and h i + 1 h_{i+1} to decide whether to cut after interior input position i i ; Appendix C specifies the BOS offset and endpoint handling.
The released model satisfies three assumptions: the mLSTM local encoder is causal, vocabulary features use only suffixes ending at the current position, and the zero-temperature threshold is deterministic.
Under these assumptions the decision is a function of the symbols through i + 1 i+1 , so two continuations with identical left context and the same first symbol must receive the same decision, regardless of training.
blocks.zh:
根据发布的"最终边界公约",预测器比较了本地编码器的预测h i h_{i}和h i + 1 h_{i+1},以决定是否在内部输入位置i i后切换;附录C规定了BOS的抵消和端点处理.
发布模型满足了三个假设: mLSTM 本地编码器是因果的,词汇特征只使用结束于当前位置的后缀,零温阈值是决定性的.
根据这些假设,决定是符号通过i+1 i+1的一个函数,所以两个左上下文完全相同的续作和同一个第一个符号必须获得相同的决定,无论训练如何.

blocks.en:
For example, after a Devanagari base, vowel sign I (U+093F) extends the cluster while letter MA (U+092E) starts a new one.
Both begin with UTF-8 byte E0 .
A target containing every cluster boundary requires opposite decisions for these continuations, which a deterministic UTF-8 predictor with one-byte lookahead cannot provide.
The same ambiguity occurs for the Bengali, Oriya, Sinhala, Thai, Myanmar, and Khmer pairs in Appendix C .
The obstruction applies to targets that require this distinction; a subset of G ⁡ ( x ) G(x) that omits both candidate cuts avoids it.
Reproducing inherited subword cuts at this lookahead, which the released predictor largely does (Section 5.2 ), is therefore a different requirement from recovering every cluster boundary.
blocks.zh:
例如,在Devanagari碱基之后,元音符号I(U+093F)在字母MA(U+092E)开始新的时,会扩展集群.
两者都以UTF-8字节E0开头.
包含每个集群边界的目标要求对这些续作相反的决定,一个具有一字节外观的确定性UTF-8预测器无法提供.
孟加拉人、奥里亚人、僧伽罗人、泰国人、缅甸人和附录C中的高棉人也存在同样的模糊之处。
这种阻碍适用于需要这种区分的目标;省略两个候选人削减的G QQ(x) G(x)子集可以避免.
因此,在这个视线前方复制继承的子字剪切,而释放的预测器主要这样做(第5.2节),与恢复每一个集群边界是不同的要求。

blocks.en:
UBE represents these scalars with UTF-16LE symbols, exposing the low byte first: 3F versus 2E in the Devanagari example.
Within a known 256-codepoint page, this symbol identifies the scalar and makes the distinction available at one-symbol lookahead.
Different pages can still collide: U+200D ZERO WIDTH JOINER and U+090D DEVANAGARI LETTER CANDRA E both start with low byte 0D .
This collision prevents a UBE predictor from reproducing every cluster boundary under the same causal, one-symbol-lookahead restriction, provided its vocabulary features obey that restriction as well.
The argument concerns prefill segmentation of observed text; during generation, the decoder predicts each byte jointly with its boundary flag.
Left context can make a continuation predictable, but encoding visibility alone does not guarantee that training will recover the desired decision.
The target specifies the required cuts; the encoding determines which distinctions the predictor can observe.
blocks.zh:
UBE用UTF-16LE符号代表这些scalars,首先揭露了Devanagari的例子中的低字节:3F对2E.
在一个已知的256码点页内,这个符号可以识别scalar,并在单音节的外观前端提供区别.
不同的页面仍然可以碰撞: U+200D ZERO WIDTH JOINER 和 U+090D DEVANAGARI 加拿大信件 E都以低字节0D开头.
这种碰撞使得UBE预测器无法在同一个因果,单音节-视星等限制下复制每个集群边界,前提是其词汇特征也服从这一限制.
该论点涉及观察文本的预填分解;在生成过程中,解码器会与其边界旗共同预测每个字节.
左侧上下文可以使延续具有可预测性,但仅编码可见度并不能保证培训能够恢复所期望的决定.
目标指定了所需的切;编码决定了预测器可以观察到的区别.

blocks.en: 4 Testing the First-Byte Bottleneck
blocks.zh: 4 测试第一Byte Bottleneck

blocks.en:
P5 establishes an information limit for specific continuations.
We next test how this limit manifests in trained predictors and natural text.
The impossibility that P5 predicts for UTF-8 and UBE-BE on the pairs below holds for any deterministic predictor with this information budget; the natural-text rates characterize the trained probes.
blocks.zh:
P5为具体续作设定了信息限制.
我们接下来测试这个极限如何表现在训练有素的预测器和自然文本中.
P5无法预测UTF-8和UBE-BE在下面的对联,这为掌握这一信息预算的任何确定性预测器提供了条件;经过培训的探测器的自然文本率是其特征。

blocks.en:
We train small causal predictors with the every-cluster-boundary target T ⁡ ( x ) = G ⁡ ( x ) T(x)=G(x) under UTF-8, UBE, and UBE-BE.
UBE-BE preserves UBE’s routing and stream length but writes each UTF-16 code unit in big-endian order, placing the page byte first for three-byte UTF-8 scalars.
All predictors use a one-layer LSTM with 512 hidden units, the same embedding-table size, and H-Net’s cosine boundary head ( Hwang et al., 2026 ) in Bolmo’s lookahead form ( Minixhofer et al., 2025 ) , comparing states k k symbols apart (Appendix D ).
The probes keep Bolmo’s boundary rule but replace its mLSTM encoder and parent-vocabulary suffix features with this LSTM.
For each encoding, we train at k = 1 , 2 , 3 k=1,2,3 with two seeds, matching FineWeb-2 text spans within each seed ( Penedo et al., 2025 ) .
For each language, training documents containing one of that language’s FLORES-200 devtest sentences are excluded.
Evaluation scores all predictors at the same 2,363,895 scalar ends of the 17-language panel.
All evaluation scalars lie in the BMP, so two UBE symbols cover each next scalar.
Each run takes 4,000 steps with 64 rows of up to 384 scalars, sampled from the same per-language training documents (the leading documents of each language’s first FineWeb-2 shard; Appendix D ).
Matching text exposure leaves computational cost unmatched because UTF-8 processes more symbol positions.
The objective gives equal aggregate weight to scalar-end and within-scalar decisions.
Balanced error is the mean of the missed-cluster-boundary rate and the false-cut rate at scalar ends inside clusters.
We pool sites across languages before averaging the two seeds, exclude sentence-final boundaries, and report within-scalar false cuts separately.
blocks.zh:
在UTF-8、UBE和UBE-BE下,我们用每个集群的边界目标T(x) = G(x) T(x) = G(x) 训练小型因果预测器。
UBE-BE保留了UBE的路由和流长,但每个UTF-16代码单元按大端顺序写,将页面字节放在三字节的UTF-8 scalars的第一位.
所有预测器都使用一个具有512个隐藏单元的单层LSTM,相同的嵌入式表大小,以及H-Net的余弦边界头(Hwang 等人,2026年)以Bolmo的外观头形(Minixhofer 等人,2025年),将状态的kk符号分开比较(附录D).
探测器保留了Bolmo的边界规则,但用这个LSTM取代了它的mLSTM编码器和父音后缀特征.
对于每次编码,我们用k=1,2,3k=1,2,3的种子进行训练,在每个种子内匹配FineWeb-2文本跨度(Penedo等人,2025年).
对于每种语言,不包括包含该语言FLORES-200 tevest句子的培训文件。
评价在17个语言面板相同的2,363,895 scalar端评分所有预测器.
所有评价的scalars都位于BMP中,因此两个UBE符号覆盖每个下一个scalar.
每次运行需4 000步,64行,最多可达384个scalars,取自相同的每种语言培训文件(FineWeb-2 shard;附录D)的样本。
匹配文本曝光使得计算成本无法匹配,因为UTF-8处理的符号位置更多.
目标对平面和平面内部的决定给予同等的总权重。
平衡误差是错失集群边界速率的平均值,以星团内部的scalar结尾的假剪速率.
在平均两种种子之前,我们汇集各种语言的场地,排除句末界限,并分别报告星空内部的错切。

blocks.en: Table 1: Balanced error (%, two-seed means) at FLORES-200 devtest scalar ends with k k symbols of lookahead. UBE-BE has UBE’s routing and stream length but reverses the byte order within each UTF-16 code unit. Within-scalar errors are reported separately in the text and Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 表1:FLORES-200 devest scalar的平衡误差(%,双种子表示值),以kk符号的外观头结尾. UBE-BE拥有UBE的路由和流长,但在每个UTF-16代码单元内反转字节顺序. 在文本和附录D中分别报告计算内错误。

blocks.en:
With one-symbol lookahead, UTF-8 misses 9.50% of cluster boundaries and places false cuts at 8.01% of scalar ends inside clusters; the corresponding UBE rates are 0.10% and 0.02% (Appendix Table 12 ).
The balanced-error differences, UTF-8 minus UBE and UBE-BE minus UBE, are 8.69 and 8.55 percentage points (95% paired source-sentence bootstrap intervals 8.63–8.76 and 8.49–8.62, conditional on two seeds).
Despite having UBE’s stream length, UBE-BE has errors comparable to UTF-8 at one symbol, supporting a role for byte order beyond stream length alone; at two symbols, where UBE-BE sees the whole next scalar and UTF-8 does not, its errors are substantially lower.
Reversing the byte order also changes the encoded history, but with the whole next scalar visible to both, UBE and UBE-BE errors nearly coincide at two symbols (Table 1 ): the contrast is concentrated at one-symbol lookahead.
UBE has the lowest one-symbol error in every panel language; its largest per-language error, in Khmer, varies across the two seeds (Appendix Table 13 ).
blocks.zh:
UTF-8带有单音节的外观,错过了9.50%的集群边界,并将错切值置于集群内8.01%的scalar端;相应的UBE率分别为0.10%和0.02%(附录表12).
平衡-偏差,UTF-8减去UBE和UBE-BE减去UBE,分别是8.69和8.55个百分点(95%对对对的源定律靴间隔8.63-8.76和8.49-8.62,条件是有两种种子)。
尽管有UBE的流长,但UBE-BE在一个符号上有与UTF-8相仿的错误,支持一个超出流长的字节顺序的作用;在两个符号上,UBE-BE看到整个下个scalar和UTF-8没有,其错误要低得多.
反转字节顺序也会改变编码的历史,但随着整个下一张标尺都可见,UBE和UBE-BE错误几乎在两个符号上吻合(表1):对比集中在单音节的外观头.
UBE在每种面板语言中有一个最小的单音节错误;其最大的每个语言错误,用高棉语,在两种种子中有所不同(附录表13).

blocks.en:
To test the information limit directly, we construct a pair from each evaluation sentence with identical left context and same-page continuations requiring opposite decisions.
A pair is correct only if both decisions are correct.
The trained UBE k = 1 k=1 predictors answer all 17,204 pairs correctly in each seed.
For UTF-8 and UBE-BE at k = 1 k=1 , the shared first symbol makes that outcome impossible for any pair, as P5 predicts.
The pairs test the predicted ambiguity by construction; their frequency does not estimate its prevalence in natural text.
blocks.zh:
为了直接测试信息限制,我们从每句评价中构造一对,左上下文相同,同一页的续作需要相反的决定.
只有两个决定都正确,一对才是正确的。
经训练的UBE k = 1 k = 1 预测器在每个种子中正确回答所有17,204对.
对于UTF-8和UBE-BE at k = 1 k = 1,共享的第一个符号使得任何一对的结果都是不可能的,正如P5预测的那样.
双胞胎通过构造来测试预测的模糊性;它们的频率并不估计其在自然文本中的普及性.

blocks.en:
Within-scalar false cuts (0.19% of within-scalar sites for UBE at k = 1 k=1 ) are not an information limit: UBE-BE, with the same symbol ranges, makes few, and under all three encodings whether a position ends a scalar is a deterministic function of the encoded prefix, so a rule-based mask can remove these cuts without changing any decision at scalar ends.
Cluster-internal decisions at scalar ends cannot be settled this way and are the subject of P5.
Configurations that see the whole next scalar still have 0.16–0.20% balanced error at scalar ends; a post hoc analysis localizes these errors primarily to positions adjacent to zero-width joiner and non-joiner characters (Appendix D ).
Away from those sites their maximum error is 0.012%.
The training sample contains almost no joiners, motivating this analysis without establishing that limited exposure caused the remaining errors.
blocks.zh:
scalar错切(0.19%的UBE在k = 1 k = 1时的scalar内切切切)不是一个信息限制: UBE-BE,具有相同的符号范围,制造次数很少,在所有三个编码下,一个位置结束一个scalar是否是编码前缀的决定性功能,所以基于规则的面具可以在scalar结尾处不改变任何决定的情况下去除这些切切切.
聚-内部决定不能以这种方式解决,而是五常的主题。
可以看到整个下个scalar的配置在scalar末端仍然有0.16–0.20%的均衡误差;后期分析主要将这些误差本地化到与零width joiner和非joiner字符相邻的位置(Appendix D ).
远离这些网站,它们的最大误差为0.012%。
培训样本中几乎没有加入者,因此没有确定有限接触造成了其余错误。

False cuts include positions inside scalars; the text denominator is shared across encodings. “Mean” weights the two languages equally. Both targets and all lookahead conditions are shown. Lower is better.
blocks.zh: 表2:韩语/中文扩展:每千个Unicode标本中误切加错目标切,平均超过3个种子. 假剪包括刻度内的位置;文本分母通过编码共享. “Mean”对两种语言的权重相等。 既显示目标,也显示所有前方条件。 低点更好

blocks.en: Table 3: Retained parent-tokenizer cuts in eight more scripts, with one predictor per language: false cuts plus missed target cuts per 1,000 Unicode scalars, averaged over 3 seeds. “UBE vs. UTF-8” is the relative change at k = 1 k=1 . The whole next scalar is visible at k = 3 k=3 for UTF-8 and at k = 2 k=2 for UBE and UBE-BE. Lower is better.
blocks.zh: 表3: 保留亲切器再切8个脚本,每个语言1个预测器:假切加每1000个Unicode斜杠错漏的目标切,平均超过3个种子. “UBE vs. UTF-8”是k=1k=1的相对变化。 整个下一个scalar在k=3 k=3时可见UTF-8,在k=2 k=2时可见UBE和UBE-BE. 低点更好

blocks.en: 4.1 Korean and Chinese: Different Boundary Targets
blocks.zh: 4.1 韩语和汉语:不同的边界目标

blocks.en:
Every cluster in the Korean and Chinese NFC evaluation sentences consists of a single scalar; modern Hangul syllables have precomposed NFC forms.
These texts therefore let us separate recovery of grapheme boundaries from selection among them.
In an exploratory extension, we train separate predictors for every cluster boundary, G ⁡ ( x ) G(x) , and for the retained-parent target, T ret ​ ( x ) T_{\mathrm{ret}}(x) , which can merge adjacent clusters into a single unit.
We use Korean and Chinese FineWeb-2 text, 3 seeds, identical sampled text spans, and matched parameter counts across encodings, excluding training documents that contain an evaluation sentence (Appendix E ).
The extension uses a smaller model and training budget than the preceding probe and is analyzed separately.
Because every cluster here is a single scalar, the every-cluster target reduces to locating scalar ends, which all three encodings expose in the encoded prefix; it does not test the first-symbol question and is reported for completeness.
Balanced error at scalar ends is undefined for that target because there are no negative sites, so we use a common metric for both targets: false cuts plus missed target cuts per 1,000 scalars, including false cuts inside scalars (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh:
韩语和中国NFC评价句中的每一组都由单音标组成;现代的汉语音节已经预先组成NFC形式.
因此,这些案文让我们把恢复石墨边界与其中的选择分开。
在探索性扩展中,我们为每个集群边界G QQ(x) G(x),以及保留-母目标T ret(x) T _{\mathrm{ret}}(x),培训单独的预测器,它们可以将相邻的集群合并为一个单元.
我们使用韩文和中国的FineWeb-2文本,3个种子,相同的样本文本跨度,并匹配参数计数跨编码,不包括包含评价句子的训练文件(Appendix E.
该扩展使用比前一个探测器更小的模型和培训预算,并分别分析.
因为这里的每一个集群都是一个单一的scalar,所以每个集群的目标都缩小到定位scalar端,所有三个编码都会在编码的前缀中暴露出来;它不测试第一符号问题,并报告完整性.
由于没有负面站点,因此该目标未定义平衡的刻度误差,因此我们对两个目标都采用了一个通用的度量标准:假切除法加上每1000个刻度误差的目标切除法,包括刻度误差(表3).

blocks.en:
UBE shortens the Korean and Chinese input streams by 29.10% and 32.05%, respectively (Appendix Table 16 ).
The parent tokenizer splits 4.74% and 0.61% of their clusters; after these internal cuts are deleted, the remaining target still distinguishes which inter-character boundaries to retain.
Stream compression and boundary prediction are therefore evaluated separately.
blocks.zh:
UBE将韩语和汉语输入流分别缩短29.10%和32.05%(附录表16).
母标记器将4.74%和0.61%的集群分割开来;在这些内部切除被删除后,剩下的目标仍然区分哪些是需要保留的特征间界限.
因此,对流压缩和边界预测分别进行评价。

blocks.en:
For the retained-parent target at k = 1 k=1 , UBE reduces errors per 1,000 scalars from 54.44 to 14.75 in Korean (72.91% reduction) and from 159.95 to 103.50 in Chinese (35.29%).
Every seed favors UBE over both UTF-8 and the same-length UBE-BE control in both languages (Appendix E ).
Relative to UBE-BE, the corresponding reductions are 41.85% and 14.63%.
UBE-BE also improves on UTF-8 here, consistent with finer distinctions among Unicode pages: Hangul syllables and the main Han ideograph block span 44 and 82 pages of 256 codepoints, respectively, whereas their UTF-8 representations have only four and six possible first bytes ( The Unicode Consortium, 2025 ) .
With the whole next scalar visible ( k = 2 k=2 ), UBE and UBE-BE have similar mean errors: their difference changes sign across seeds in each language (Appendix Table 18 ) and both sentence-bootstrap intervals span zero (Appendix Table 19 ), consistent with a byte-order advantage concentrated at one-symbol lookahead.
Comparisons with UTF-8 at k = 3 k=3 still differ in encoded history, sequence length, and optimization, even though all configurations expose the whole next scalar.
blocks.zh:
对于保留在k=1k=1的家长目标,UBE将韩语中每千只标尺的误差从54.44降至14.75(减幅72.91%),中文中从159.95降至103.50(35.29%).
每个种子都优于UBE同时优于UTF-8和两种语言的相同长度的UBE-BE控制(附录E.
相对于UBE-BE,相应的降幅分别为41.85%和14.63%.
UBE-BE也改善UTF-8, 汉语的音节和汉语的主要象形文字块分别跨度为44和82页,共256个编码点,而他们的UTF-8表示器仅有4和6个可能的首字节(The Unicode Consortium, 2025).
随着整个下一个scalar可见(k = 2 k = 2),UBE和UBE-BE也有类似的平均差错:它们的差异变化在每种语言的种子间都显示(Appendix表18),两句-bootstrap间隔跨度均为0(Appendix表19),与集中在单音节外观头的字节顺序优势一致.
k=3 k=3时与UTF-8的比较在编码历史,序列长度和优化方面仍然有所不同,尽管所有配置都暴露了整个下一个scalar.

blocks.en:
A post hoc partition locates the gain at scalar gaps without adjacent whitespace as well as in the aggregate (Appendix E ).
Among scalar gaps with no whitespace on either side, the k = 1 k=1 error rate falls from 9.94% to 2.69% in Korean and from 17.11% to 10.93% in Chinese.
These rates use only the gaps in each stratum, excluding within-scalar positions.
This partition describes where the errors occur; it does not isolate the effect of a language’s spacing convention.
blocks.zh:
一个后临时分区在没有相邻的白空间以及集合(Appendix E )的情况下,在scalar空隙中定位增益.
在两侧无白空空空隙中,k=1k=1误差率从朝鲜语的9.94%下降到2.69%,汉语的误差率从17.11%下降到10.93%.
这些比率只使用每一层的空隙,不包括在平面内的位置。
此分区描述错误发生的地方; 它不会孤立语言间隔协议的效果 。

blocks.en: 4.2 Eight More Scripts
blocks.zh: 4.2 增加八个脚本

blocks.en:
We repeat the retained-parent comparison in Japanese, Thai, Lao, Khmer, Burmese, Hindi, Bengali, and Tamil, training one predictor per language with the settings, conditions, and 3 seeds of Section 4.1 (Table 3 ; Appendix F ).
In all of these scripts except Japanese, the letters of the main Unicode block share one 256-codepoint page, so the first symbol of UBE-BE, like the first byte of UTF-8, is the same for every letter, whereas UBE’s first symbol identifies the letter within the page.
Japanese kana and kanji, like Chinese characters, span many pages.
At one-symbol lookahead, UBE reduces errors relative to UTF-8 in every language and seed; the three-seed mean falls by 67.32% in Japanese and up to 99.55% in Hindi.
In the single-page scripts, UBE-BE stays within 3.0% of UTF-8, so at equal stream length the gain follows byte order; in Japanese, UBE-BE recovers part of the gap (109.8 against 118.7 errors per 1,000 scalars, and 38.8 for UBE).
UBE at k = 1 k=1 already achieves at least 92% of the error reduction that UTF-8 obtains by extending its lookahead from one byte to the whole next scalar, and the differences between encodings shrink once each sees the whole next scalar.
Retraining the Korean and Chinese retained-parent predictors of Section 4.1 reproduces their weights exactly and adds evaluations every 250 updates: UBE’s seed-mean error at k = 1 k=1 stays below UTF-8 at every checkpoint and reaches UTF-8’s final error after 500 of 2,000 updates in Korean and 750 in Chinese (Appendix Table 24 ).
In each of the eight new scripts, UBE’s seed-mean error at k = 1 k=1 is already below UTF-8’s final error at the first checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
我们重复以日语、泰语、老挝语、高棉语、缅甸语、印地语、孟加拉语和泰米尔语进行保留父母的比较,
除日文外,所有这些脚本中,Unicode主块的字母共用一个256码点的页面,因此UBE-BE的第一个符号与UTF-8的第一个字节一样,每个字母都是相同的,而UBE的第一个符号则在页面中识别该字母.
日语kana和kanji与汉字一样,跨越许多页.
在单音节外观前,UBE会减少每种语言和种子中相对于UTF-8的错误;三种子平均日语下降67.32%,印地语下降高达99.55%.
在单页脚本中,UBE-BE停留在UTF-8的3.0%以内,所以在相等的溪流长度上,收益遵循字节顺序;在日语中,UBE-BE回收了部分缺口(109.8对每1000scalars118.7错,UBE38.8错).
k = 1 k = 1 的 UBE 已经实现了 UTF-8 通过将它的望角从一个字节扩展至整个下一个scalar 获得的至少92%的减错,而编码之间的差别在每次看到整个下一个scalar后都会缩小.
第4.1节的韩国和中国保留型预测器的再训练, UBE在 k = 1 k = 1 时的种子- 误差, 在每个检查点都保持在 UTF-8 下方, 并在 韩文 和 750 中文 的 500 个更新后达到 UTF-8 的最终误差(附录表 24 ).
在8个新剧本中,UBE在k=1 k=1时的种子-平均值错误已经低于UTF-8在第一个检查站的最后错误.

blocks.en: 5 Inherited Segmentation in Released Conversions
blocks.zh: 5 释放转化中的继承分裂

blocks.en:
The retained-parent target of Section 3 removes cluster-internal cuts from inherited supervision.
This section measures what released conversions inherit and how to evaluate them: boundary retention (Section 5.2 ), sequence lengths under inherited and cluster-aligned targets (Section 5.3 ), sensitivity to span-preserving edits (Section 5.4 ), mark–base corruption contrasts (Section 5.5 ), and the scoring choices that a comparison with the parent requires (Section 5.6 ).
blocks.zh:
第3节保留家长制的目标排除了集群内部削减的继承监督。
本节衡量所释放的转换继承的东西和如何评价它们:边界保留(第5.2节)、继承目标下的序列长度和集群对应目标(第5.3节)、对保持间距编辑的敏感性(第5.4节)、标记-基准腐败对比(第5.5节)以及与母体进行比较所需的评分选择(第5.6节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Checkpoints and Measurement
blocks.zh: 5.1 检查站和计量

blocks.en:
We study three released conversions, two of them paired with their parent models.
Bwen-8B is a conversion of Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base from the Qwen3 family ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , although its tokenizer configuration names Qwen/Qwen3-8B ; the loaded tokenizers have identical SHA-256 digests in the measurement records.
The second behavioral pair is allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B , from the OLMo 2 family ( OLMo Team et al., 2025 ) , and allenai/Bolmo-1B .
We additionally inspect allenai/Bolmo-7B , whose weight lineage starts from Olmo-3-1025-7B ( Olmo Team et al., 2025 ) .
The latter two conversions share the dolma2 tokenizer but differ in backbone and training history as well as size.
Public revisions and measured runtime identities appear in Appendix M .
blocks.zh:
我们研究了三个释放的转换,其中两个与他们的母模型对齐.
Bwen-8B是Quen3家族(Yang等人,2025年)的Quen/Quen3-8B-Base的转换,尽管其标注器配置名称为Quen/Quen3-8B;加载的标注器在测量记录中具有相同的SHA-256文摘.
第二行为对是Alenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B,来自OLMo 2家族(OLMo Team等人,2025年),和Alenai/Bolmo-1B.
此外,我们还检查了Alenai/Bolmo-7B,其体重线起自Olmo-3-1025-7B(Olmo Team等人,2025年)。
后两种转换方式共用dolma2表示器,但骨干、训练历史和体积不同。
公共修订和计量的运行时间身份载于附录M。

blocks.en:
We audit natural-text boundaries in float32, processing one unpadded sentence per forward pass through the checkpoint’s local encoder and boundary predictor.
The audit reconstructs the exact NFC bytes from parent pieces, validates the cut-offset mapping against shifted alternatives, and verifies the loaded encoder tensors.
The embedding-removal ablation drops the residual parent-vocabulary feature without retraining.
Corruption scores use bfloat16 standalone forwards on a smaller selected item bank; their patch counts are reported separately.
blocks.zh:
我们用浮标32来审核自然文本的边界,
审计从母件中重建准确的NFC字节,验证了针对变换的替代品的截断式映射,并验证了装入的编码器载数计.
嵌入式迁移消退法在不进行再培训的情况下,降低了父母所在地的剩余特性。
腐败分数使用bfloat16独立前行在较小的选定项目库上;其补丁计数单独报告.

blocks.en: 5.2 Boundary Retention
blocks.zh: 5.2 边界保留

blocks.en:
The audit first measures how much inherited segmentation fragments grapheme clusters.
Across the focal languages, Bwen retains at least 97.07% of its parent’s interior cuts in each language, and its cluster-internal cut count A in A_{\mathrm{in}} differs from the parent’s by at most 1.54%.
This agreement emerges from the predictor’s own decisions; the evaluation does not impose parent boundaries.
Retention varies more widely across the control languages (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh:
审计首先衡量了所继承的石墨片段有多少。
Bwen至少保留了97.07%的家长内部切口,
这一协议来自预测者自己的决定;评价并不强制规定母边界。
保留在各控制语言(附录A)之间差别较大。

blocks.en: Table 4: Boundary audit totals over all 22 languages. N N counts text units, A in A_{\rm in} cuts strictly inside a grapheme cluster, and B in B_{\rm in} cuts strictly inside a Unicode scalar; “Split” is the percentage of multi-scalar clusters that receive at least one cut. † Without the parent-vocabulary embedding, no retraining.
blocks.zh: 表4:所有22种语文的边界审计总数。 N计算文本单位, A in A_{\rm in} 严格切入一个图解组, B inrm 严格切入一个Unicode scalar; “ Split” 是指至少获得一个切出的多刻度组的百分比 。 没有母省嵌入,没有再培训。

blocks.en:
Across the full audit, Bwen splits 99.49% of multi-scalar clusters, compared with the parent’s 99.89% (Table 4 ).
The close agreement extends to both boundary positions and the proportion of clusters fragmented in this released lineage.
blocks.zh:
在全面审计中,Bwen将99.49%的多级星系划分为99.89%(表4)。
密切协议既包括边界位置,也包括在这一已释放的分界线中支离破碎的集群比例。

blocks.en:
Removing the parent-vocabulary embedding reduces the number of internal cuts in many languages while also coarsening the segmentation: the largest ratio of parent to ablated interior-cut counts is 15.6 × \times (Appendix Table 9 ).
The ablated predictor still splits 66.18% of the full audit’s multi-scalar clusters and makes some within-scalar cuts in Chinese.
Because removal changes both the input features and embedding magnitude without retraining, this intervention demonstrates sensitivity to the vocabulary feature.
It neither establishes a repair at matched granularity nor identifies that feature as the sole source of inherited segmentation.
blocks.zh:
移除父- vocabulary 嵌入可以减少许多语言的内部切数, 同时压缩分割: 最大比例的 父与减速内切数为 15. 6 ×\ tims( 附录表 9 ) 。
减速的预测器仍然将全部审计的多标码组的66.18%拆分,并用中文进行一些中标内切.
由于去除既会改变输入特征,又会改变嵌入量而不进行再培训,这种干预显示出对词汇特征的敏感性.
它既没有确定相应的颗粒性修复,也没有确定该特征是继承分化的唯一来源。

blocks.en:
Patch counts provide complementary evidence on the uncorrupted texts in the mark/base probe.
For Bwen, the pooled patch-to-parent-token ratio is 0.9977, item-level Pearson correlation is r = 0.9998 r=0.9998 , and 97.4% of items agree within 5% relative difference; language-level ratios range over 0.9710–1.0213 .
On its own bank, Bolmo-1B shows similarly close count agreement with OLMo-2-0425-1B : pooled ratio 0.9988, r = 0.9999 r=0.9999 , and 99.6% of items within 5%, using the parent-tokenizer loading convention in Appendix J .
These smaller-bank measurements record counts only; positional agreement is established by the full Bwen audit.
blocks.zh:
补丁计数为标记/基准探测器中未损坏的文本提供了补充证据。

Independent decoding of parent pieces also fails to provide a general mapping: 1,448 of the parent’s 151,643 ordinary vocabulary pieces are not valid standalone UTF-8 strings; byte-level tokenizers place no UTF-8 constraint on token formation ( Firestone et al., 2025 ) .
Their embedding identifiers remain usable, but transferring those features to new symbol positions requires an explicit alignment policy.
The cluster-aligned construction in Section 3 resolves the representability of the boundary target; it leaves vocabulary-feature transfer as a separate design choice.

blocks.en: 5.4 Sensitivity to Span-Preserving Edits

blocks.en:
Natural-text boundary agreement does not determine how segmentation responds to edits.
We construct paired mark and base substitutions within the same multi-scalar cluster, each replacing one scalar with another of the same script association and UTF-8 width while preserving NFC and every grapheme span.
At least one substitution changes Bwen’s patch count in 1,786 of 3,400 items (52.5%).
A count change establishes a segmentation change, although an unchanged count can conceal moved boundaries.

至少一个替换变化 Bwen的补丁数在3,400件物品中的1,786件(52.5%)。

The selected 200 parallel source sentences yield 3,400 items per parent/conversion pair.
Each pair shares an item bank, while the banks differ between pairs.

blocks.en: 5.6 Scoring Parent Models and Byte Conversions
blocks.zh: 5.6 计算父模型和字节转换

blocks.en:
Interpreting the corruption contrasts requires three scoring choices to be explicit (Appendix K ).
First, the scored byte suffix must match the parent’s scored tokens under an explicit prefix convention: prepending the parent’s declared BOS raises the cost of otherwise unchanged targets by 74.2%.
Second, batch composition can alter patch positions and decisions in the released wrappers; it changes Bwen’s selected boundary path in 10 of 306 tested variants.
We therefore score each variant in a standalone forward pass.
Third, the joint byte/flag score conditions on one selected boundary history.
It measures the cost of that path, whereas text likelihood requires marginalization over alternative boundary histories.
The same distinction holds for tokenized models: a string’s probability sums over every token sequence that decodes to it, not only the canonical one ( Cao and Rimell, 2021 ; Chirkova et al., 2023 ; Vieira et al., 2025b ) .
Our parent score likewise follows one canonical tokenization (Appendix I ).
blocks.zh:
解释腐败对比要求三个评分选择要明确(附录K ).
首先,得分的字节后缀必须在明确的前缀惯例下与父母的得分符号相匹配:在父母申报的BOS预置时,否则会提高74.2%的目标成本。
其次,批量成分可以在释放的包装中改变补丁位置和决定;它会改变Bwen在306个测试变体中的10个选定的边界路径.
因此,我们以单独的前传方式对每个变体进行评分。
第三,联合字节/旗对一个选定的边界历史进行评分的条件。
它衡量这条道路的成本,而文本的可能性则要求人们忽视其他边界历史。
对象征性模型来说,同样的区别是:一个字符串的概率总和超过每一个给它解码的符号序列,而不只是条形符号(Cao and Rimell, 2021;Chirkova等人, 2023; Vieira等人, 2025b)。

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
Models operating below the subword level differ in both representation and allocation of computation.
ByT5 uses bytes in a text-to-text transformer ( Xue et al., 2022 ) , CANINE downsamples character inputs ( Clark et al., 2022 ) , and MambaByte uses a selective state-space model ( Wang et al., 2024 ) .
MEGABYTE separates local and global computation with fixed patches ( Yu et al., 2023 ) ; SpaceByte places global computation at “spacelike” positions such as UTF-8 leading bytes, whitespace, and punctuation ( Slagle, 2024 ) ; BLT selects patches using entropy ( Pagnoni et al., 2025 ) .
Learned segmentation takes several forms: dynamic token pooling learns boundaries or supervises them with subword or entropy targets ( Nawrot et al., 2023 ) , MrT5 learns deletion ( Kallini et al., 2025 ) , and H-Net learns chunking ( Hwang et al., 2026 ) ; AU-Net instead builds an autoregressive hierarchy over rule-based word splits ( Videau et al., 2025 ) .
MAGNET routes each byte sequence through a boundary predictor for its script, with per-script compression targets chosen to make segmentation granularity similar across scripts ( Ahia et al., 2024 ) .
FLEXITOKENS allows a range of boundary rates during adaptation ( Owodunni et al., 2026a ) , while Fast BLT and dynamic multi-byte prediction target decoding efficiency ( Kallini et al., 2026 ; Owodunni et al., 2026b ) .
These architectures treat compression and boundary placement as explicit design choices.
Our analysis concerns the information that an encoding exposes to the boundary predictor, particularly when supervision is inherited from a subword model.
The distinctions we study, such as a dependent mark versus a letter after the same base, arise within one script and usually within one 256-codepoint page, so routing by script, as in MAGNET, does not supply them.
The study of entropy-based patch allocation at matched patch counts by Vera Zúñiga (2026) addresses a complementary question, and SOMBRERO scores boundaries by how strongly chunk starts concentrate on bytes that are hard to predict ( Neitemeier et al., 2026 ) ; our audit uses grapheme integrity as the boundary criterion.
blocks.zh:
在分词级别以下操作的模型在计算的代表和分配上都有所不同.
ByT5在文本变换器中使用字节(Xue等人,2022年),CANINE降标字符输入(Clark等人,2022年),曼巴比特使用选择性的状态空间模型(Wang等人,2024年).
MEGABYTE用固定的补丁(Yu等人,2023年)将局部和全局计算分开;SpaceByte将全球计算置于UTF-8领先的字节,白空,点球等"类似空间"位置(Slagle,2024年);BLT使用 en选择补丁(Pagnoni等人,2025年).
学习的分化有多种形式:动态符号集合学习边界或用子词或 en目标监督边界(Nawrot等人,2023年),MrT5学习删除(Kallini等人,2025年),H-Net学习块化(Hwang等人,2026年),AU-Net相反,在基于规则的单词分化上建立了自动递进的等级(Vieau等人,2025年)。
MAGNET通过对脚本的边界预测器来引导每个字节序列,并选择标注的压缩目标,以在脚本之间形成相似的分区颗粒性(Ahia等人,2024年).
传单 在适应过程中允许一系列边界率(Owodunni等人,2026a),而Fast BLT和动态多字节预测目标解码效率(Kallini等人,2026;Owodunni等人,2026b).
这些架构将压缩和边界布置视为明确的设计选择.
我们的分析涉及编码暴露于边界预测器的信息,特别是当监管从一个子词模型中继承时。
我们所研究的区别,如依赖标记与同一基数之后的字母的区别,在一个脚本中产生,通常在一个256个代码点的页面中产生,因此按照脚本的路由,如MAGNET,不能提供它们.
Vera Zúñiga(2026年)在匹配的补丁计数中研究了基于肽的补丁分配,解决了一个互补的问题,SOMBRERO通过如何强烈的块开始集中于难以预测的字节来评分边界(Nestileier等人,2026年);我们的审计使用石墨完整性作为边界标准.

blocks.en:
Bolmo transfers a pretrained model into a byte architecture through distillation ( Minixhofer et al., 2025 ) , whereas zero-shot tokenizer transfer predicts embeddings for a replacement tokenizer ( Minixhofer et al., 2024 ) .
H-Net similarly distills Llama 3.2 3B into a byte-level model around its frozen backbone, supervising the routing module with the parent’s token starts and noting that these boundaries cannot always be predicted online ( Hwang et al., 2026 , Appendix E.2) .
Inference-time methods instead expose a tokenized model as a byte- or character-level distribution without training ( Phan et al., 2025 ; Vieira et al., 2025a ; Hayase et al., 2026 ) ; byteification trains local modules and a boundary predictor around the parent transformer.
Concurrent work adapts H-Net-style dynamic byte chunking to a frozen subword model, pulling chunk embeddings toward averaged subword embeddings and adding part-of-speech tagging supervision to guide word-level boundaries ( Kumar et al., 2026 ) .
Vocabulary expansion based on hidden-state similarity can consolidate multi-token characters in a frozen model ( Churchill and Skiena, 2026 ) .
Closer to our boundary question, Haltiuk (2026) reports nearly inherited Bolmo segmentation, proposes capability-preserving boundary transfer, and asks which shared alphabet to use.
We give cluster-aligned target constructions and analyze their predictability at limited lookahead.
blocks.zh:
Bolmo通过蒸馏(Minixhofer等人,2025年)向字节结构转移一个预先训练过的模型,而零镜头的代币转移则预言会嵌入替换的代币(Minixhofer等人,2024年).
H-Net同样地将Llama 3.2 3B蒸馏成围绕其冷冻骨干的一个字节级模型,用母体的标志启动来监督路由模块,并指出这些界限不能总是在线预测(Hwang等人,2026年,附录E.2).
相反,推论时间方法将象征性模型暴露为未经过培训的字节或字符级分布(Phan等人,2025年;Vieira等人,2025年a;Hayase等人,2026年);字节化培训本地模块和母变压器周围的边界预测器。
同时期工作将H-Net风格的动态字节块调整到一个冷冻的子词模型,将块嵌入到平均子词嵌入,并添加部分语义标记监督,以指导词级边界(Kumar等人,2026年)。
基于隐藏态相似性的词汇扩展可以在冷冻模型中整合多键字符(Churchill and Skiena, 2026) .
Hartiuk(2026年)报告几乎继承了Bolmo分区,
我们给出了集群组合目标构建,并在有限的视线前分析其可预测性。

blocks.en:
Alternative encodings provide another way to change the representation presented to a tokenizer or model.
MYTE uses morpheme inventories ( Limisiewicz et al., 2024 ) , and SCRIPT combines Unicode script/category structure with constrained merges ( Land and Arnett, 2025 ) .
BBPE16 motivates UTF-16LE byte tokenization by removing the format bits of three-byte UTF-8 encodings and evaluates BPE on those bytes in multilingual speech recognition ( Kim et al., 2026 ) .
Bit-level BPE repacks and deduplicates UTF-8 prefix bits in Korean, Chinese, and Japanese byte fallbacks ( Moon et al., 2025 ) ; Latom learns corpus-dependent atomic character codes ( Hiraoka, 2026 ) .
UBE routes scalars through UTF-8 or UTF-16LE according to their UTF-8 length, assigning the routes disjoint alphabets ( Kim and Jung, 2026 ) .
We compare this representation with UTF-8 and a matched-length big-endian control to study boundary prediction across scripts at limited lookahead.
blocks.zh:
替代编码提供了另一种方法,可以将所呈现的表示方式改为标注符或模型.
MYTE使用morpheme编目(Limisiewicz等人,2024年),SCRIPT将Unicode脚本/类结构与限制合并(Land and Arnett,2025年)合并.
BBPE16通过删除三字节UTF-8编码的格式位点,激发UTF-16LE字节符号化,并在多语种语音识别中的这些字节上评价BPE(Kim等人,2026年).
比特级BPE在韩语,汉语和日语的字节后缀中重新包装和调试UTF-8前缀比特(Moon 等人,2025年);拉图姆学习命题依赖原子字符代码(平冈,2026年).
UBE路线通过UTF-8或UTF-16LE按照其UTF-8的长度,指定路线脱节字母(Kim和Jung,2026年).
我们把这一表述与UTF-8和匹配长的大端控制进行比较,以研究在有限视线前方对脚本的边界预测.

blocks.en:
Grapheme pair encoding initializes BPE with graphemes ( Velayuthan and Sarveswaran, 2025 ) , MorphTok constrains dependent-vowel segmentation ( Brahma et al., 2025 ) , type-driven tokenization extends tokens to orthographic boundaries ( Kapila and Bagavathy, 2026 ) , and WWHO preserves rule-defined syllables ( Darshana, 2026 ) .
These constraints refer to different written units.
Indic grapheme parsers model orthographic syllables ( Ansary et al., 2024 ) , while a Devanagari grapheme-cluster tokenizer has been evaluated on Hindi and Marathi tasks ( Dwivedi and Gopalan, 2026 ) .
Word-pooled tokenization groups bytes or characters at word boundaries ( Thawani et al., 2023 ) ; HAT uses whitespace or Unicode word splits ( Neitemeier et al., 2025 ) .
Korean methods exploit Jamo in character representations or tokenization ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) , or use morpheme analysis to constrain subword segmentation ( Lee et al., 2026a ) .
Our target construction uses Unicode grapheme clusters to constrain inherited cuts, while the predictor analysis asks whether the available encoded prefix distinguishes the required decisions.
blocks.zh:
Grapheme配对编码初始化了带有石墨的BPE(Velayuthan and Sarveswaran, 2025),MorphTok限制依附-沃爾分類(Brahma等人, 2025),类型驱动的代号将符号延伸至正线边界(Kapila and Bagavathy, 2026),WWHO保留规则定义的音节(Darshana, 2026).
这些限制是指不同的书面单位.
数字图形解析器模型 (Ansary等人,2024年),而Devanagari phrameme-cluster的标语器则被评价为印地语和马拉地语的任务(Dwivedi和Gopalan,2026年).
单词集合的符号化组合在单词边界上的字节或字符(Thawani等人,2023年);HAT使用白空或Unicode单词分裂(Neitemeier等人,2025年).
韩国的方法利用Jamo在性格表示或象征化(Kim等人,2024年;Lee等人,2025年),或使用morpheme分析来限制子词的分化(Lee等人,2026年a). 。 。 。
我们的目标构造使用Unicode phrameme集群来限制继承的剪切,而预测器分析则询问可用的编码前缀是否区分了所需的决定.

blocks.en:
H-Net evaluates learned chunking against a SpaceByte-style rule on Chinese text without regular word spaces ( Hwang et al., 2026 ) .
Our whitespace partition instead characterizes errors in predicting retained parent cuts; its targets are inherited subwords, not linguistic word labels.
Thunder-Tok filters vocabulary candidates that mix complete characters with incomplete byte fragments but allows isolated fragments of a single character ( Cho et al., 2026 ) , so it does not guarantee grapheme integrity.
Constructed combinations of incomplete tokens can cause failures ( Jang et al., 2025 ) , yet single-token Chinese characters can also perform worse on character-structure tasks ( Haslett, 2025 ) .
These task-dependent findings support evaluating boundary prediction, symbol compression, and linguistic quality as distinct outcomes; morphological alignment, measured across 70 languages, likewise explains little of the variance in the downstream performance of five pretrained models ( Arnett et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
H-Net根据SpaceByte风格的规则,对没有普通文字空间的中文文本进行分块评估(Hwang等人,2026年)。
我们的白空分区相反地定性了在预测保留父切片时的错误;它的目标是继承的子词,而不是语言词标签.
Thunder-Tok过滤词汇考生将完整的字符与不完整的字节片段混合,但允许单个字符的孤立片段(Cho et al., 2026),因此不能保证石墨的完整性.
构造式组合的不完全符可造成故障(Jang等人,2025年),然而单键汉字也可以在字符结构任务上表现更差(Haslett,2025年).
这些依赖于任务的调查结果支持评价边界预测、符号压缩和语言质量作为不同的结果;按70种语言衡量的形态吻合同样没有说明五个预先训练过的模型(Arnett等人,2025年)下游性能的差异。

blocks.en:
Controlled tokenizer comparisons, multilingual token lengths, and commercial token pricing document disparities in representation cost ( Rust et al., 2021 ; Petrov et al., 2023 ; Ahia et al., 2023 ) .
The Southeast Asian comparison by Lee et al. (2026b) also finds unequal language-level patch parity for BLT, extending this concern to entropy-based patching.
Analysis of UTF-8’s efficiency and equity tradeoffs motivates considering alternative input encodings ( van der Goot, 2026 ) .
Work on vowel signs identifies letter-category pretokenization as one source of fragmentation in abugidas ( Regmi et al., 2026 ) , supporting the distinction between scalar and cluster boundaries without explaining every observed cut.
blocks.zh:
受控的代币比较,多语种代币长度,商业代币定价文件在代表成本方面的差异(Rust等人,2021年;Petrov等人,2023年;Ahia等人,2023年).
Lee等人(2026年b)的东南亚比较也发现BLT语言层次的补丁不平等,将这种担忧扩展到了以肽为基础的补丁.
分析UTF-8的效率与权益权衡,
有关元音符号的工作将字母类前缀识别为 abugidas(Regmi 等人,2026年)中分裂的一个源头,支持区分scalar和集群边界而不解释每个观察到的切.

blocks.en:
Character-level evaluation provides a separate perspective on these representations.
CUTE tests orthographic knowledge and manipulation ( Edman et al., 2024 ) .
Bolmo reports approximately 75 million tokens of English-only CUTE-style tasks (about 0.04% of its data), augmenting approximately 172 billion Dolma 3 tokens counted with the Dolma2 tokenizer ( Minixhofer et al., 2025 , Section 4 and Appendix C) .
Our mark/base substitutions measure relative corruption penalties, which complement task-based character evaluation but do not provide a general character-understanding score.
blocks.zh:
特征级评价为这些表述提供了单独的观点。
CUTE测试正交知识和操纵(Edman等人,2024年).
Bolmo报告了大约7500万个仅使用英语的CUTE风格任务的代币(约占其数据的0.04%),增加了约172亿多尔玛3个代币,与Dolma2代币器一起计算(Minixhofer等人,2025年,第4节和附录C).
我们的标记/基准替代衡量相对腐败处罚,这些惩罚补充了基于任务的性格评价,但没有提供一般性格理解的分数。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en:
The lookahead evidence comes from small causal predictors with 2 seeds on the 17-language panel and 3 on the Korean/Chinese extension; the sentence-bootstrap intervals do not capture variation over training runs.
Text exposure is matched across encodings but compute is not, and UBE-BE changes the entire encoded history as well as the first lookahead symbol.
The first-symbol argument covers continuations within a known Unicode page; cross-page collisions preclude a universal one-symbol guarantee.
The released-model analyses cover two parent families and one family of conversion recipes on FLORES-200 devtest translations, and because the checkpoints differ in architecture, size, data, and training history, their comparison does not isolate the effect of byte-level modeling.
blocks.zh:
外观证据来自小的因果预测器,17语言面板上有2个种子,朝鲜/中国扩展面有3个种子;句子-波茨夹间隔不能捕捉训练过程中的变异.
文本曝光是跨编码匹配的,但计算不是,UBE-BE会改变整个编码历史以及第一个望头符号.
首音符参数涵盖已知Unicode页面中的续作;跨页碰撞排除了通用的单音符保证.
发布模型分析涵盖了FLORES-200 devtest翻译上的两个家长家庭和一个转化食谱家庭,由于检查站在建筑,大小,数据,培训历史等方面不同,它们的比较并不孤立字节级模型的作用.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
Boundary prediction depends on how an encoding exposes the distinctions relevant to a writing system and segmentation target.
Bwen largely reproduces its parent’s cuts, including those inside grapheme clusters, and Bolmo-1B’s patch counts track its parent’s token counts; restricting inherited cuts to grapheme boundaries removes this fragmentation from supervision and yields targets representable across encodings.
For scalars requiring three UTF-8 bytes, UBE’s UTF-16 route removes the format-bit overhead and places the low byte first, making within-page character distinctions available earlier.
At one-symbol lookahead, the trained UBE and UBE-BE predictors support the importance of byte order for grapheme boundary recovery and for retained subword boundary selection.
In Korean and Chinese, where the every-cluster target is already recoverable from scalar ends, UBE reduces retained-parent errors relative to UTF-8 by 72.91% and 35.29% at the same lookahead; in eight more scripts, by 67.32% to 99.55%.
Which byte comes first, not only how many bytes a scalar takes, is therefore a design choice for byte-level boundary predictors.
blocks.zh:
边界预测取决于编码如何暴露与书写系统和分区目标有关的区别。
Bwen基本上复制了父母的切口,包括石墨组内部的切口,Bolmo-1B的补丁计数跟踪了父母的代号数;将继承的切口限制在石墨边界上,消除了这种从监管中分解出来的现象,并产生可代表各种编码的目标。
对于需要3个UTF-8字节的scalar,UBE的UTF-16路由取消了格式位头,将低字节放在首位,使页内字符区分更早可用.
在单音节外观前,训练有素的UBE和UBE-BE预测器支持字节顺序对于石墨边界恢复和保留子词边界选择的重要性.
在韩语和汉语中,每个集群目标都已经可以从Scalar端可回收,UBE相对于UTF-8,将保留-母错误减少72.91%和35.29%;在另外8个脚本中,将保留-母错误减少67.32%至99.55%.
哪个字节是第一位的, 不仅仅是一个字节需要多少字节, 因此是字节级边界预测器的设计选择。

blocks.en: Impact Statement
blocks.zh: 影响说明

blocks.en:
This work examines how text encodings affect boundary prediction and representation length across writing systems.
It provides ways to identify and measure design choices that fragment written units or disproportionately lengthen some languages’ representations.
The selected languages and translated corpus do not cover all users, dialects, or writing practices, and Unicode grapheme clusters provide an operational definition of written units with language-specific limits.
Changes in representation can redistribute computational cost and model quality across scripts.
Assessing their social benefit requires native-language evaluation that reports both gains and regressions.
blocks.zh:
这项工作研究了文本编码如何影响跨写作系统的边界预测和表示长度.
它提供了确定和衡量设计选择的方法,这些选择将书面单元分割开来,或使一些语文的表述过于冗长。
所选语言和译本并不涵盖所有用户,方言,或写作惯例,Unicode phrameme集群提供了具有语言特定限制的书面单位的操作定义.
代表性的变化可以重新分配计算成本和整个脚本的模型质量.
评估他们的社会福利需要用当地语言进行评价,既报告收益,又报告倒退。

blocks.en:
Each of the 18 runs trains a predictor with a 513-entry, 128-dimensional symbol embedding (including padding), a one-layer causal LSTM with 512 units, layer normalization, and H-Net’s cosine boundary head ( Hwang et al., 2026 ) as adapted in Bolmo ( Minixhofer et al., 2025 ) .
The head places a cut after position i i when ( 1 − cos ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( h i ) , g ⁡ ( h i + k ) ) ) / 2 > 1 / 2 (1-\cos(f(h_{i}),g(h_{i+k})))/2>1/2 , where f f and g g are learned linear projections.
Training runs for 4,000 steps with 64 rows per step.
Each row begins at a uniformly sampled cluster start in a uniformly sampled language and contains up to 384 supervised scalars, followed by up to three scalars of unsupervised lookahead context.
Row sampling depends only on the seed, ensuring identical text exposure across encodings and lookahead settings within a seed.
The loss adds the mean binary cross-entropy (BCE) over scalar-end decisions to the mean BCE over within-scalar decisions.
We use AdamW with learning rate 2 × 10 − 3 2\times 10^{-3} , weight decay 0.01, 100 warmup steps followed by cosine decay to one tenth, and gradient norm clipping at 1; BCE probabilities are clipped to [ 10 − 3 , 1 − 10 − 3 ] [10^{-3},1-10^{-3}] .
The encoder and projections use bfloat16, with the cosine and loss computed in float32.
For each language, training uses whole documents in file order from the first FineWeb-2 shard until the retained NFC text reaches at least 8 million UTF-8 bytes.
For each language, documents containing one of that language’s FLORES-200 devtest sentences are excluded.
Targets are extended grapheme cluster boundaries from the same regex library version as the boundary audit.
This design matches training text while allowing symbol counts and FLOPs to differ; UTF-8 processes more positions.
The two loss terms have equal aggregate weight, but their gradients can differ across encodings.
UBE-BE preserves UBE’s symbol count and loss weights while reordering the entire encoded history, so its contrast with UBE includes effects on history representation and optimization as well as the first lookahead symbol.

blocks.en:
Each sentence also supplies a same-context continuation pair.
At a site where a base letter precedes a scalar on the same 256-codepoint page, the true continuation is paired with an NFC-stable replacement from that page requiring the opposite decision.
A pair is correct only when both decisions are correct.
Encoding alone determines the minimum lookahead needed to distinguish them: UTF-8 requires two bytes for 9,313 pairs and three for the remaining 7,891; UBE requires one symbol for every pair, and UBE-BE requires two.
UTF-8 and UBE-BE therefore have zero fully correct pairs at k = 1 k=1 and exactly 50% decision error on these pairs by construction.
The trained UBE k = 1 k=1 predictors answer every pair correctly, whereas UTF-8 at k = 2 k=2 answers 27.2–28.8% of all pairs correctly (4,676 and 4,949 pairs in its two seeds), although two bytes distinguish 9,313 pairs.

因此,UTF-8和UBE-BE在k = 1 k = 1时有0个完全正确的配对,并且通过构造在这些配对上完全有50%的决定错误.

blocks.en: Appendix E Korean and Chinese Boundary Extension

blocks.en:
Designed after the original probe, this exploratory extension examines boundary prediction in Korean and Chinese.
Both targets and all 36 runs are reported, with no checkpoint or condition selected by evaluation performance.
The every-cluster target is G ⁡ ( x ) G(x) ; the retained-parent target keeps Qwen3 cuts at those cluster boundaries and deletes all other cuts.
The retained target represents inherited subword supervision, not Korean morpheme or Chinese word annotations.
Targets are computed from full-document tokenizations and grapheme segmentation before sampling rows, preserving the original context rather than retokenizing cropped spans.

Any training document containing an evaluation sentence from either language is dropped.
The corpus revision, NFC normalization, grapheme library, and Qwen3 tokenizer match the pinned artifacts reported in Appendix M .
Each predictor has a 513-entry, 128-dimensional embedding, a one-layer 256-unit LSTM, and the original probe’s cosine head, totaling 592,512 parameters in every condition.
Training runs for 2,000 steps with 32 rows per step.
Rows begin at uniformly sampled cluster starts in a uniformly selected language, with up to 128 supervised scalars and three additional scalars for lookahead.
We use float32 throughout and retain the original probe’s AdamW optimizer, learning rate, schedule, clipping, and two-term loss.
Text spans are identical across targets, encodings, and lookahead settings within each seed.
The design therefore matches text exposure and parameter counts while allowing symbol counts and FLOPs to differ.
As in the original probe, UBE-BE changes the encoded history as well as the lookahead symbols.
All evaluation scalars lie in the BMP, so UTF-8 at k = 3 k=3 and UBE or UBE-BE at k = 2 k=2 see the whole next scalar on these texts.
blocks.zh:
对于每种语言,我们保留了第一种FineWeb-2 shard的全部文档,直到NFC文本至少达到800万UTF-8字节.

校正、NFC规范化、石墨库和Qune3 装饰剂与附录M中报告的固定文物相匹配。
每个预测器有一个513进,128维的嵌入,一个一层256单元的LSTM,以及原探测器的余弦头,每个条件总共592,512个参数.
训练为2 000步,每步32行。
行从统一抽样的集群开始,以统一选择的语言开始,最多128个有监督的scalars和另外3个用于寻找头的scalars.
我们在整个过程中使用浮点32,并保留原探测器的亚当W优化器,学习率,进度,剪辑,以及两期损失.
