blocks.en:
We evaluate all 1,012 devtest sentences per language in separate forward passes.
The primary metric sums missed target cuts, false cuts at scalar ends, and false cuts inside scalars, then divides by the original scalar count and multiplies by 1,000.
Sentence-final scalar ends are excluded from the error count; positions inside the final scalar are included.
Using the original scalar count keeps the denominator independent of the number of available cut sites under each encoding.
Supporting missed-boundary and scalar-end false-cut rates (Table 20 ) use their respective positive and negative site counts.
F1 includes within-scalar false cuts, whereas the cluster-split rate counts each affected cluster once.
Reported values average per-seed ratios; the “Mean” column in Table 3 then weights the two languages equally.
Contrasts use 2,000 paired source-sentence bootstrap draws, shared across parallel translations, seeds, and conditions.
The 95% percentile intervals condition on the three trained seeds and are descriptive, without multiplicity correction; Table 18 shows each seed separately.
blocks.zh:
我们用单独的前行通行证对每种语言的所有1 012句句子进行评估。
初等的量子数错失了目标切数,假的切数在鳞片末端,假的切数在鳞片内部,然后用原来的鳞片数除以1千倍.
句子-最终的scalar句尾不包括在错误计数中;包含在最终的scalar句中的位置.
使用原始的scalar计数使分母独立于每个编码下可用的切点数.
支持错失边界和卡片末端错剪率(表20)使用各自的正负站点计数.
F1包含在卡内误切,而集群分裂率则计算每个受影响的集群一次.
表3中的“Mean”栏对两种语文进行同等加权。
对比点使用2,000对对源定律图纸,在平行翻译、种子和条件之间共享。
三种经过培训的种子95%的间隔条件是描述性的,没有多重更正;表18分别列出每个种子。

blocks.en: Table 16: Korean/Chinese structural accounting on NFC devtest. “Retained” counts target units after deleting incompatible Qwen3 cuts. “Split” is the percentage of clusters split by Qwen3, before deletion. Stream savings compare UBE symbols with UTF-8 bytes; UBE-BE has the same length as UBE.
blocks.zh: 表16:NFC devest上的韩国/中国结构核算. “保留”在删除不兼容的Qune3削减之后计算目标单位。 “Split”是指在删除之前将星团除以Qwen3的百分比。 流省将UBE符号与UTF-8字节进行对比;UBE-BE的长度与UBE相同.

blocks.en:
Neither NFC evaluation set contains a multi-scalar cluster, so every evaluated scalar end is a grapheme boundary.
The every-cluster target consequently has no negative scalar-end class, making balanced error undefined.
A deterministic scalar decoder recovers this target without error (Table 17 ), providing a structural baseline rather than a learned predictor with a matched information budget.
For the retained-parent target, the same rule oversegments; predicting no cuts provides the complementary constant-label baseline.
blocks.zh:
NFC的评价集都没有包含一个多scalar集群,所以每个被评价的scalar端都是一个石墨边界.
因此,每个集群的目标都没有负的分级,使得平衡错误没有定义。
确定性分解器可以毫无错误地恢复这一目标(表17),提供结构基线,而不是具备相应信息预算的有学识的预测器。
对于保留父母的目标,同样的规则是优先;预测不削减提供补充性常数标签基线。

blocks.en: Table 17: Deterministic baselines in errors per 1,000 Unicode scalars. Both respect scalar interiors.
blocks.zh: 表17:每千 Unicode scalars中误差的决定因素基线. 两者都尊重scalar内饰.

blocks.en: Table 18: Errors per 1,000 Unicode scalars for every trained seed, including within-scalar cuts.
blocks.zh: 表18:每1 000人的错误 每个训练过的种子的Unicode scalars,包括scalar内切.

blocks.en: Table 19: UBE-minus-control contrasts in errors per 1,000 Unicode scalars; negative values favor UBE. Intervals resample parallel source sentences and condition on the three seeds.
blocks.zh: 表19:每千 Unicode scalars中误差的UBE-减去控制对比;负值偏好UBE. Intervals 重现三个种子上的平行源句和条件.

blocks.en: Table 20: Supporting metrics, averaged over the three seeds. Within-scalar cuts use the common text denominator; missed boundaries and scalar-end false cuts use their own class denominators. A dash means the negative scalar-end class is absent. F1 includes within-scalar false cuts; “Split” counts clusters with at least one internal cut.
blocks.zh: 表20:支持度量衡,三个种子的平均值. 刻度内切使用共同的文本分母;省略的边界和刻度末端的假切使用自己的类分母. 一个破折号表示负的平面末级缺失. F1 包括 scalar 内假切; “ Split” 计数至少有一个内切的集群 。

blocks.en:
We replay all 18 retained-parent predictors on CPU, first verifying exact agreement with the original aggregate counts for every sentence.
Interior scalar gaps are then partitioned using the recorded Python runtime’s Unicode whitespace predicate.
The four disjoint strata have whitespace only to the right (before whitespace), only to the left (after whitespace), on both sides (between whitespace), or on neither side; sentence endpoints are excluded.
Table 21 gives the gap counts and target-cut frequencies.
Whitespace constitutes 21.86% of Korean scalars and 2.44% of Chinese scalars, so the Chinese text contains whitespace despite its lack of regular word spacing.
blocks.zh:
我们在CPU上重播所有18个保留了的家长预测器,首先核实每个句子与原总数的确切一致.
使用 Python 运行时的Unicode 白空间上游进行分割。
四个脱节层只有右侧(在白空间之前)的白空间,只有左侧(在白空间之后),两侧(在白空间之间)的白空间,或者两侧均没有;句尾点被排除.
表21列出了差距数和目标剪切频率。
白空占朝鲜语 s字的21.86%,占汉语cal字的2.44%,所以虽然没有固定的字间隔,但汉语文本中却包含了白空.

blocks.en:
Table 22 reports missed cuts plus false cuts as a percentage of each stratum’s gaps, averaged across seeds.
Within-scalar errors remain part of the primary metric but lie outside this scalar-gap partition.
The analysis was chosen after the aggregate results and describes errors on the original inputs; it neither removes whitespace nor evaluates linguistic word segmentation.
Every before-whitespace gap is a positive target in these texts, while most after-whitespace gaps are negative, making the distinction between the two sides consequential.
At gaps with no adjacent whitespace, UBE’s k = 1 k=1 error is lower than both controls in every seed of each language.
Chinese gaps immediately after whitespace show the opposite pattern, favoring both UTF-8 and UBE-BE over UBE.
blocks.zh:
表22. 平均而言,在每一层的缺额中,缺额加上假缺额的百分比。
刻度内误差仍然是主要衡量标准的一部分,但位于这个刻度-刻度分区之外。
分析是在汇总结果后选择的,并描述了原始输入的错误;它既不去除白空,也不评价语言词段.
在这些文本中,每个前白空隙都是正目标,而大多数后白空隙都是负目标,使得双方的区别随之而来.
在没有相邻白空间的空隙中,UBE的 k = 1 k = 1 错误低于每种语言的每个种子中的两个控件.
白空之后的中国空隙立即显示相反的图案,偏向于UTF-8和UBE-BE都优于UBE.

blocks.en: Table 21: Whitespace partition of the retained-parent target. Counts refer to interior scalar gaps; target-cut percentages use the row’s gap count. A dash marks an absent stratum.
blocks.zh: 表21:保留父母目标白空分区. 计数是指内部的scalar差距;目标剪切百分比使用行的差数. 一个破碎的标志 一个缺席的阶层。

blocks.en: Table 22: Post hoc scalar-gap error percentages by whitespace context. “Before,” “After,” and “Between” refer to whitespace; “Neither side” has no whitespace on either side. All encoding/lookahead conditions are included, with 3-seed means. These percentages have different denominators from the primary errors per 1,000 scalars.
blocks.zh: 表22:按白空格上下文分列的临时缩写-gap后误差百分比。 “其后”和“Between”是指白空间;“任何一方”在两边都没有白空间。 所有编码/视标条件都包含在内,有3种子手段. 这些百分比的分母与每1,000平方尺的主要差错不同。

blocks.en: Appendix F Eight More Scripts and Learning Curves
blocks.zh: 附录F 更多脚本和学习曲线

blocks.en:
This exploratory extension repeats the retained-parent comparison of Appendix E in eight more languages: Japanese ( jpn_Jpan ), Thai ( tha_Thai ), Lao ( lao_Laoo ), Khmer ( khm_Khmr ), Burmese ( mya_Mymr ), Hindi ( hin_Deva ), Bengali ( ben_Beng ), and Tamil ( tam_Taml ).
Each predictor is trained on one language only, with the model, optimizer, 2,000 steps of 32 rows, six encoding and lookahead conditions, and 3 seeds of Appendix E ; text spans are identical across conditions within each language and seed.
For each language, we retain whole documents from the first FineWeb-2 shard until the NFC text reaches at least 8 million UTF-8 bytes; no retained document contains a FLORES-200 devtest sentence of any of the eight languages.
Targets keep the Qwen3 cuts that fall on extended grapheme cluster boundaries and delete all others, so outside Japanese they also remove cuts inside multi-scalar clusters.
We evaluate all devtest sentences of each language after every 250 updates and report all 144 runs.
Intervals use 2,000 paired source-sentence bootstrap draws shared across seeds and conditions and are conditional on the 3 seeds.
All evaluation scalars lie in the BMP, so UTF-8 at k = 3 k=3 and UBE or UBE-BE at k = 2 k=2 see the whole next scalar.
blocks.zh:
这一探索性扩展重复了以另外8种语言对附录E的保留父母比较:日语(jpn_Jpan),泰语(tha_Thai),老挝语(lao_Laoo),高棉语(khm_Khmr),缅甸语(mya_Mymr),印地语(hin_Deva),孟加拉语(ben_Beng),泰米尔语(tam_Taml).
每个预测器只接受一种语言的训练,模型,优化器,2000步32行,6个编码和望头条件,以及附录E的3个种子;文本跨度在每种语言和种子中的条件相同.
对于每种语言,我们保留了第一个FineWeb-2 shard的全部文件,直到NFC文本至少达到800万UTF-8字节;没有保留的文件包含一个FLORES-200的八种语言中的任何一个的devest句子.
目标保留掉落在扩展的石墨集群边界上的Quen3切片,并删除所有其他,因此在日语之外,它们也会去除多scalar集群内的切片.
每250个更新后,我们评估每种语言的所有句子,并报告所有144个运行情况。
间歇期使用2000对对的源定律靴子抽取不同种子和条件共享,并以3个种子为条件.
所有评价的scalars都位于BMP中,因此UTF-8在k=3k=3,UBE或UBE-BE在k=2k=2中可以看到整个下一个scalar.

blocks.en:
The main blocks of Thai (U+0E00–U+0E7F), Lao (U+0E80–U+0EFF), Khmer (U+1780–U+17FF), Myanmar (U+1000–U+109F), Devanagari (U+0900–U+097F), Bengali (U+0980–U+09FF), and Tamil (U+0B80–U+0BFF) each lie on a single 256-codepoint page ( The Unicode Consortium, 2025 ) .
Every letter of such a block therefore has the same first UTF-8 byte ( E0 or E1 ) and the same first UBE-BE symbol, its page, whereas its first UBE symbol is its position within the page.
Japanese text mixes hiragana and katakana from their main blocks, which share one page, with kanji spread over many, so UBE-BE’s first symbol separates these kana from kanji and distinguishes kanji pages.
The texts also contain Latin letters, digits, and punctuation, so a constant first symbol within one block does not by itself determine the learned error.
blocks.zh:
泰语(U+0E00–U+0E7F),老挝语(U+0E80–U+0EFF),高棉语(U+1780–U+17FF),缅甸语(U+1000–U+109F),德瓦纳加里语(U+0900–U+097F),孟加拉语(U+0980–U+09FF),泰米尔语(U+0B80–U+0BFF)等主要区块均位于单256个编码点上(Unicode Consortium,2025).
因此,这种块的每个字母都有相同的第一个UTF-8字节(E0或E1)和相同的第一个UBE-BE符号,它的页面,而它的第一个UBE符号是它在页面中的位置.
日文将hiragana和katakana从主要块混合起来,它们共享一页,kanji分布在许多块,因此UBE-BE的第一个符号将这些kana与kanji分开,并区分kanji的页.
文本中还包含拉丁字母,数字,和标点符号,因此一个块内一个恒定的第一个符号本身并不能决定学到的错误.

blocks.en:
Table 23 gives the paired contrasts.
UBE at k = 1 k=1 has fewer errors than both UTF-8 and UBE-BE in every seed of every language, and every interval for these two contrasts excludes zero.
In the single-page scripts, UBE-BE differs from UTF-8 by at most 3.0% at k = 1 k=1 , and UBE’s reduction relative to UBE-BE is at least 97% of its reduction relative to UTF-8.
In Japanese, UBE-BE lies between UTF-8 and UBE.
Table 24 lists the seed-mean errors at every checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
表23给出了成对对比。
K=1 k=1的UBE在每种语言的每个种子中,都比UTF-8和UBE-BE的误差都少,这两种对比的每个间隔都排除0.
在单页脚本中,UBE-BE与UTF-8相比,在k = 1 k = 1时,与UTF-8相比,UBE的还原至少是其还原量的97%.
在日语中,UBE-BE位于UTF-8和UBE之间.
表24列出每个检查站的种子-平均值错误。

blocks.en:
To obtain learning curves for the Korean/Chinese predictors, we retrained the 18 retained-parent runs of Appendix E with checkpoint evaluations.
Every retrained model has the same text spans, bitwise identical weights, and the same final counts as the original run, so the Korean and Chinese curves in Table 24 belong to the predictors reported in Table 3 .
blocks.zh:
为了获得韩国/中国预测器的学习曲线,我们对附录E的18个保留型父母运行进行重新训练,并进行检查站评价。
每个重新训练的模型都有相同的文字跨度,位点相同的权重,最终计数与原运行相同,因此表24中的韩文和中文曲线属于表3中报告的预测器.

blocks.en: Table 23: Paired contrasts for the eight-script extension: differences in errors per 1,000 scalars between three-seed means, each with its 95% source-sentence bootstrap interval in brackets below. Negative values favor the first encoding. The whole-next-scalar columns compare UBE at k = 2 k=2 with UTF-8 at k = 3 k=3 and with UBE-BE at k = 2 k=2 .
blocks.zh: 表23:Paired对八标扩展的对比:三种子手段之间每千只标尺的差错,每只标尺在下面的括号中为95%的源判靴间隔. 负值偏好第一个编码 。 全-下行-scalar列在k=2 k=2时与UTF-8在k=3 k=3时与UBE-BE在k=2 k=2时进行比较.

blocks.en: Table 24: Learning curves at one-symbol lookahead ( k = 1 k=1 ): retained-parent errors per 1,000 scalars after each number of updates, averaged over three seeds. The final column equals the k = 1 k=1 values in Tables 3 and 3 .
blocks.zh: 表24 学习曲线在单音节外观(k = 1 k = 1 ):每次更新数后每1000scalars保留-母错误,平均值为3个种子. 最后一栏等于表3和表3中的 k = 1 k = 1 值。

blocks.zh: 附录G 完全行为对比和敏感性

blocks.en:
Tables 25 and 26 report both parent/conversion pairs, each evaluated on its own matched item bank and prefix convention.
Mark and base margins are increases in path cost relative to the original text, averaged in bits; R R is the mean mark margin divided by the mean base margin. Δ ​ R \Delta R and Δ ​ I \Delta I denote conversion-minus-parent differences.
All mean base margins are positive, so larger R R indicates larger relative mark penalties.
Smaller I I indicates a shift toward mark penalties under item-level normalization; the two summaries use different weights and need not move together.
blocks.zh:
表25和26分别报告了母对/对转换的对子,每个对子都根据自己的匹配项目银行和前缀惯例进行了评估。
标记和基边是路径成本相对于原始文本的增加,以比特表示平均值;RR是除以平均基边的平均值标记差. R \ Delta R 和 \ I \ Delta I 表示转换- 最小- 母性差异 。
所有中基差均为正差,因此较大的RR表示较大的相对标记罚.
小一点 我表示,在项目层面的正常化下,正在转向给罚以标记;两份摘要使用不同的权重,无需一起行动。

blocks.zh: 表25: Quen3-8B-Base和Bwen-8B,每种语言200项. 平滑, 指向百分位间隔; 没有多重修正 。

blocks.zh: 表26:OLMo-2-0425-1B和Bolmo-1B,每种语言200项. 这家银行使用OLMo母代碼器大会. 它的物品和前缀不需要与第一对的相同.

Panel intervals use 4,000 paired percentile bootstrap draws of the 200 source sentences, retaining all 17 translations and both models together.
Per-language intervals instead resample that language’s items, again keeping models paired.
The panel ratio pools margins before division, implicitly weighting languages by each model’s mean base margins.
It therefore differs from both an unweighted mean of language ratios and an average of language differences under common weights.
The item contrast gives equal weight to each defined item.
Both intervals remain conditional on the selected checkpoints and languages.
blocks.zh:
面板间隔使用4000对百分位的靴子图画200个源句,保留了全部17个翻译和两个模型.
换句话说,
划分前的面板比集合比值,暗含着以每个模型的平均基值加权的语言.
因此,它不同于未加权的语言比率平均值和共同加权下的平均语言差异。

blocks.zh: 表29:未加权的皮尔逊协会相对于语言总量. 它们没有确定一种机制或传播总量中的不确定性。

blocks.en:
The two model sizes also differ in pretrained backbone and training history, so agreement supports recurrence within this conversion family without ruling out model-specific effects.
Flag shares are measured only on original sentences; explaining corruption margins would additionally require flag measurements on the edited texts.
blocks.zh:
两种模型大小在预训骨干和培训史上也有不同,因此协议支持在这个转换家族中重现,而不排除模型的特定效果.

blocks.en: Appendix I Scoring Protocol and Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 附录一 校准规程和诊断

blocks.en:
Let t 0 t_{0} be the first ordinary parent token and n 0 n_{0} the number of bytes recovered from its byte-alphabet representation.
The scorer verifies that concatenating the bytes of all parent pieces reconstructs the exact NFC sentence.
Recovering piece bytes avoids decoding t 0 t_{0} in isolation, which can replace an incomplete scalar with a replacement character, because byte-level pieces need not be valid UTF-8 ( Firestone et al., 2025 ) .
Each corruption preserves t 0 t_{0} , ensuring that the scored suffix begins at the same byte offset across variants within a pair.

The parent cost is − log 2 ⁡ P ⁡ ( t 1 , … , t n − 1 ∣ t 0 ) -\log_{2}P(t_{1},\ldots,t_{n-1}\mid t_{0}) , without a prepended BOS or appended EOS.
The conversion receives its BOS and prefix bytes under the boundary history selected during prefill; the first n 0 n_{0} byte targets are excluded from the score.
The models therefore score the same text suffix under different conditioning representations.
With one-byte lookahead, the final unscored prefix flag can depend on the first scored byte.
This is a byte-level analogue of the prompt boundary problem of tokenized models ( Vieira et al., 2025a ; Hayase et al., 2026 ) .
In the Bwen bank, 0 of 6,800 corruptions change the recorded prefix flags.
This is a measured property of these items; preserving the first parent token alone does not guarantee unchanged prefix flags.

blocks.en:
The measured wrapper pools up to the largest patch count in a batch, leaving surplus gathered states in rows with fewer patches.
During prefill, it shifts real patch states to the right while retaining shared position identifiers, and the scoring call supplies no attention mask for padded patches.
Batching can also change decisions near the boundary threshold.
On natural text, 8 of 7,407,006 Bwen interior positions lie within 10 − 4 10^{-4} of the threshold; this threshold-distance diagnostic does not establish a hardware-independent error bound.
Table 31 quantifies the resulting changes under this wrapper and scoring protocol.
blocks.zh:
测量到的包装池达到一个批次中的最大补丁计数,使多余的收集状态排成行,补丁更少.
在预填时,它会将真正的补丁状态向右移动,同时保留共享位置标识符,积分调用会为添加补丁提供不注意遮罩.
Batching也可以改变靠近边界阈值的决定.
关于自然文本,7 407 006中的8个 Bwen内部位置位于阈值的10−4 10^{-4};这种阈值-距离诊断没有建立硬件独立的误差约束.
表31按此包装和评分协议对由此产生的变化进行量化。

blocks.en: Appendix J Tokenizer Loading in the Second Pair
blocks.zh: 附录 J 切除器 装入第二对

blocks.en:
The dolma2 and OLMo-parent tokenizers have matching serialized vocabularies and tokenizer components after merge-format normalization, but the recorded runtime loads different pretokenizer backends.
It loads a bare byte-level pretokenizer for dolma2 while preserving the split-then-byte sequence from the OLMo model repository.
Both are fast tokenizers; the discrepancy concerns segmentation behavior, not the choice of a fast or slow implementation.
blocks.zh:
dolma2和OLMo-parent代碼器在合并格式正常化后有匹配序列化词汇和代碼元件,但所记录的运行时间负载会不同预tokenizer后端.
它为 dolma2 装入一个赤色字节级的预tokenizer,同时从OLMo模型寄存器中保留了分裂时字节序列.
两者都是快速的表示器;差异涉及分化行为,而不是选择快速或慢执行.

blocks.en:
To hold bank and prefix construction fixed within the behavioral pair, both arms use the OLMo parent’s loaded tokenizer, overriding the conversion’s declared dolma2 tokenizer.
The instability comparison between the two conversions instead uses the default dolma2 convention.
Loading checks compare vocabularies, byte mappings, and expansion tries.
Flattening pieces into bytes removes their canonical boundaries, while suffix lookup supplies vocabulary identifiers independently of those boundaries.
Consequently, identical byte inputs and expanded identifiers can coexist with different canonical tokenizations.
The behavioral comparison is conditional on the shared OLMo-parent convention.
blocks.zh:
将银行和前缀构造固定在行为对内,
两种转换之间的不稳定性比较使用默认的dolma2常规.
装入检查比较词汇,字节映射,并尝试扩展.
将棋子拼成字节可以去除其犬科的边界,而后缀检索则可以独立于这些边界提供词汇标识符.
因此,相同的字节输入和扩展的标识符可以与不同的条形符号共存。
行为比较以共享的OLMo-parent常规为条件.

blocks.en: Appendix K Comparison Pitfalls
blocks.zh: 附录K 比较 坑头

blocks.en:
Under the Qwen tokenizer’s default settings, no BOS is added and the first token provides context.
Our protocol scores the remaining tokens and the matching byte suffix in the conversion, with no EOS target.
Prepending the declared BOS changes both the conditioning and the scored span: across 51 sentences, the cost of the unchanged suffix targets rises by 74.2%.
This increase is 11.0 times the additional cost of scoring the first token.
The result demonstrates why a comparison must state its prefix convention; lower cost under one convention does not establish greater fairness.
blocks.zh:
在 Quen 指示器 的默认设置下, 不添加 BOS , 第一个指示符提供上下文 。
我们的协议在转换中给剩下的符和匹配的字节后缀打分,没有EOS目标.
在宣布的BOS同时改变条件和得分跨度之前:跨越51句,不变后缀目标的成本上升了74.2%.
这一增加是记分第一的额外费用的11.0倍。
结果表明,为什么比较必须说明其前缀公约;一项公约规定的较低费用不能确立更大的公平性。

blocks.en:
Strings of equal byte length can have different patch counts.
The released wrapper’s pooling and padding path can then introduce surplus patch states and shifted positions without a matching padding mask, a sensitivity observed in all three wrappers under this protocol.
For Bwen-8B, batching changes costs by up to 12.32 bits and moves the selected boundary path in 10 of 306 variants.
The corresponding maxima and counts are 41.28 bits and 11/2,550 for Bolmo-1B, and 20.88 bits and 29/2,550 for Bolmo-7B.
Standalone forwards avoid this measured dependence on batch composition.
blocks.zh:
等位字节长度的字符串可以有不同的补丁计数.
释放的包装器的集合和粘贴路径随后可以引入剩余补丁状态,并在没有匹配的粘贴面罩的情况下移位,这是在本协议下所有三个包装器中观察到的灵敏度.
对于Bwen-8B,批量改变成本最高可达12.32比特,并在306个变体的10个中移动选定的边界路径.
相应的最大和计数是41.28比特和11/2550比特为Bolmo-1B,20.88比特和29/2550比特为Bolmo-7B.
独立前进可避免这种对批量成分的依赖。

blocks.en:
The joint byte/flag score follows the conversion’s selected boundary history.
On the matched subset, conditional flag surprisal accounts for 13.0% of Bwen’s path cost as an unweighted mean across languages (Table 30 ).
This decomposition does not imply a segmentation cost unique to byte models: selecting a BPE token also selects its extent during generation.
Removing flag terms leaves byte probabilities conditioned on one history, whereas marginal text likelihood sums over alternative histories.
Appendix I specifies the prefix audit and final-flag marginalization.
blocks.zh:
联合字节/旗分数跟随转换选定的边界历史.
在匹配的子集上,有条件的旗子占Bwen路径成本的13.0%,作为跨语言的未加权平均值(表30).
这种分解并不意味着字节模型独有的分割成本:选择一个BPE令牌也会在生成过程中选择其范围.
删除旗词时,字节概率取决于一个历史,而边际文本概率则大于其他历史。

blocks.en: Appendix L Scope of the Boundary-Target Proposal
blocks.zh: 附录L 边界目标提案的范围

blocks.en:
Stage-1 distillation aligns each patch with a parent token.
Deleting boundaries merges parent units into longer patches, requiring teacher representations and decoder targets to be aligned to the merged spans.
Target construction uses full-text Unicode segmentation; P5 and the probe characterize the information available to reproduce those labels at inference.
The existing boundary loss is the natural supervision point, with the Stage-1 pipeline changes described in Sections 2 and 3 .
blocks.zh:
阶段一蒸馏将每个补丁与父代号对齐.
删除边界会将母单位合并成更长的补丁,要求教师的表示和解码目标与合并的跨度一致.
目标构造采用Unicode的全文分区;P5和探测器对可用信息进行定性,以便推断复制这些标签。
现有的边界损失是自然监督点,第2节和第3节中描述了第1阶段管道的变化。

blocks.en:
Boundary placement and patch count are separate experimental factors.
Isolating cluster alignment requires an unaligned control with the same per-sentence target count, together with comparisons at matched realized density.
Within an encoding, a target comparison must also hold initialization, architecture, and evaluation fixed.
Across encodings, preserving the unrestricted parent target requires an explicit remapping policy; direct transfer to UBE need not be representable.
blocks.zh:
边界放置和补丁计数是单独的实验因素.
隔离集群调整要求采用与平均判决目标数相同的不协调控制,同时进行相应的密度比较。
在编码中,目标比较还必须固定初始化、结构和评价。
在整个编码中,保留不受限制的母目标需要明确的再规划政策;直接转移到UBE不需要具有代表性.

blocks.en:
Matching training text leaves computational cost dependent on the local encoder, global transformer, local decoder, and output head.
Target and realized A in A_{\mathrm{in}} , B in B_{\mathrm{in}} , patch density, edit sensitivity, and language-model quality therefore remain distinct outcomes.
Sequence lengths alone do not determine prefill or decoding latency, peak memory, or sensitivity to batch size and padding.
Language-level results are also necessary to detect regressions concealed by aggregate quality.
P1–P5 characterize the target segmentation and the information available to a causal boundary predictor.
blocks.zh:
匹配训练文本的计算成本取决于本地编码器,全局变压器,本地解码器和输出头.
因此,目标并实现A在A_{\mathrm{in}},B_{\mathrm{in}},补丁密度、编辑敏感性和语言模型质量仍然是显著的结果。
单是序列长度不能决定预填或解码时空,峰值内存,或对批量大小和垫装的敏感性.
语文一级的结果对于检测总质量所掩盖的回归也是必要的。
P1-P5对目标分解和因果边界预测器可用信息作了描述。

blocks.en:
The float32 boundary audit verifies exact byte reconstruction after NFC and confirms that the unshifted offset mapping agrees with parent cuts more closely than either adjacent shift.
Its padding diagnostic verifies that changed decisions were close to the threshold before padding; a separate bfloat16 check applies autocast to the same checkpoint weights.
The cost accounting verifies exact agreement with the audit’s scalar and parent-unit counts for shared languages.
Behavioral comparisons check item identities, source indices, tokenizer digests, and scored byte windows within each pair.
The flag decomposition additionally matches the subset bank and its stored path costs.
blocks.zh:
浮点32边界审计验证NFC之后的精确字节重建,并证实未转移的抵消映射与母切切比相邻的切换更接近.
其粘贴诊断核实改变的决定在粘贴之前接近阈值;单独的bfloat16检查适用于相同的检查站重量。
成本核算核实了与审计的分级和母单位计算共用语文的确切一致。
行为比较检查项目身份,源索引,标致器文摘,并在每对内打分字节窗口.
旗子分解还符合子库及其存储路径成本.

blocks.en:
All reported corpus measurements, accounting densities, and descriptive correlations derive from fixed measurement records.
Training-mixture sizes are attributed to Bolmo’s authors, and the lookahead examples are constructed encoding checks.
The tables retain the recorded confidence intervals; the leave-one-language-out analysis recomputes point estimates only.
The cost and audit records’ text and parent-token counts are reproduced exactly from the pinned FLORES-200 devtest cache listed above; the normalization and grapheme tables come from distinct Unicode databases.
blocks.zh:
所有报告的实体计量、核算密度和描述性关联都来自固定的计量记录。
培训-混合尺寸可归因于Bolmo的作者,外观前方的例子是构建的编码检查。
这些表格保留了记录的置信间隔;一个字不写的分析只重新计算点数估计数。
成本和审计记录的文字和亲子数据完全来自上面列出的FLORES-200devest缓存;正常化和石墨表格来自不同的Unicode数据库。
